english: Skuppah is an old place on the Fraser River, downstream from its meeting with the Thompson. It lies within the country of the Nlaka'pamux, whose fishing places and routes follow the river through a steep canyon. In 1808 Simon Fraser's party passed through this river country with Indigenous guides, navigating rapids and traveling on foot where the water was too dangerous for their canoes.
simp_chinese: 斯库帕是弗雷泽河畔一处古老的地方，位于该河与汤普森河交会处的下游。这里属于恩拉卡帕穆克斯人的土地，渔场和道路沿河穿过陡峭峡谷。1808年，西蒙·弗雷泽的队伍在原住民向导陪同下经过这片河谷，穿行急流；水势过于险恶、独木舟无法通行时，他们便改为步行。

english: The Skurweberge rise in the folded mountain country north of the Ceres valley. Their ridges run roughly north to south, enclosing the Agter-Witzenberg valley with the neighbouring Witzenberg range. Passes through these heights gave access to the Warm and Cold Bokkeveld; many followed older paths used by Khoekhoe and San travellers. The higher Cold Bokkeveld stands well above the warmer valley below, with mountain streams draining into the country between the ranges.
simp_chinese: 斯库尔韦山矗立在塞雷斯河谷以北的褶皱山地。山脊大致南北延伸，与邻近的维岑贝格山脉共同围出阿赫特维岑贝格谷地。穿越高地的山口通向温暖和寒冷的博克维尔德；其中许多沿用了科伊科伊人和桑人行走的旧路。寒冷博克维尔德的高地远高于下方较温暖的河谷，山间溪流则流向群山之间的土地。

english: Skvyra lies in the country southwest of Kyiv, in the basin of the Ros. The old settlement was destroyed at the end of the sixteenth century, but a village of the same name was recorded again in 1736. Its eighteenth-century community included Jewish families: the census of 1765 counted 51 Jewish-owned houses among 124 in the settlement. Skvyra's later growth built upon this renewed village and its local market.
simp_chinese: 斯克维拉位于基辅西南方的罗斯河流域。旧居民点在十六世纪末被毁，但1736年的记载中又出现一座同名村庄。十八世纪当地社群包括犹太家庭：1765年的人口调查记下全村124户房屋，其中51户为犹太人所有。斯克维拉后来在这座重建的村庄和当地市场基础上发展起来。

english:
Skwierzyna stands at the confluence of the Obra and Warta rivers in western Poland. It developed from a Slavic fishing settlement on a route linking Szczecin and Kraków, and already possessed town privileges by 1296. King Władysław Jagiełło renewed those privileges in 1406.

The town received a coat of arms in 1530 and became a royal town of the Polish Crown in 1543. Prussia annexed it in the Second Partition of Poland in 1793. It formed part of the Duchy of Warsaw from 1807 to 1815, before returning to Prussian administration.
simp_chinese:
斯克维日纳位于波兰西部奥布拉河与瓦尔塔河汇合处，原为连接什切青和克拉科夫商路上的斯拉夫渔村。到1296年，它已拥有城镇特权；1406年，国王瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃重新确认了这些权利。

城镇于1530年获得纹章，1543年成为波兰王室城镇。1793年第二次瓜分波兰时，普鲁士吞并此地。1807至1815年间，它属于华沙公国，此后重新归入普鲁士行政体系。

english:
Skye's deeply indented coast surrounds a landscape of moors and mountains, dominated by the jagged Cuillin. Dunvegan Castle, overlooking a sea loch on the western side of the island, has long been the seat of the MacLeods. The MacDonalds of Sleat held lands on the Sleat peninsula elsewhere on Skye, and rivalry between the two families repeatedly disturbed the island.

In 1601 their feud culminated in the battle of Coire na Creiche on the northern slopes of the Cuillin. The MacDonalds defeated the MacLeods, but the Scottish Privy Council intervened to end the fighting between the two rival clans. Peace was celebrated with feasting at Dunvegan Castle, where the opposing chiefs were brought together after the bitter contest on the island.
simp_chinese:
斯凯岛的海岸曲折多湾，环绕着荒原和山地，锯齿般的库林山脉雄踞其中。西岸邓韦根城堡俯瞰一处海湾，长期以来是麦克劳德家族的驻地。斯利特的麦克唐纳家族则掌握岛上其他土地，两家的争斗屡次搅扰岛屿。

1601年，世仇在库林山北坡的科里纳克里赫战役中达到高潮。麦克唐纳家族击败麦克劳德家族，但苏格兰枢密院出面平息争端。苦战之后，双方首领在邓韦根相聚，以宴饮庆祝和平。

english: Slagelse stands in western Zealand, near the Viking ring fortress of Trelleborg, built around 980. A church stood in Slagelse itself by the eleventh century, when coins were also struck there. Valdemar I founded nearby Antvorskov in the twelfth century for the Knights Hospitaller. Erik V granted Slagelse market-town privileges in 1288, placing it in competition with the neighbouring towns of Korsør and Skælskør. A new road from Copenhagen to Korsør passed through Slagelse in the 1780s.
simp_chinese: 斯劳厄尔瑟位于西兰岛西部，靠近约980年建造的维京环形堡垒特雷勒堡。十一世纪，镇上已有教堂，也铸造钱币。十二世纪，瓦尔德马一世在附近为医院骑士团创建安特沃斯科夫修道院。1288年，埃里克五世授予斯劳厄尔瑟集镇特权，使它与附近的科瑟和斯凯尔斯克竞争。1780年代修建的哥本哈根至科瑟道路经过这里。

english:
Slana lies in interior Alaska, where river valleys connect the upper Copper and Tanana country. Athabaskan communities used fishing and hunting places across this country and kept routes between their seasonal camps.

Russian maritime expansion touched coastal Alaska more directly than inland districts, although goods and news could still pass through Indigenous trade networks. Communities kept relationships with neighbouring peoples across mountains and watersheds.
simp_chinese:
斯拉纳位于阿拉斯加内陆，河谷连接科珀河上游与塔纳纳地区。阿萨巴斯卡原住民社群在这一带利用渔场和猎场，并维持季节营地之间的道路。

俄国海上扩张对阿拉斯加海岸的影响比内陆地区更加直接，但货物和消息仍可通过原住民的交易网络传播。社群跨越山地和分水岭与邻近人群保持联系。

english: Slănic lies in the hills north of the Wallachian plain, where deposits of rock salt gave the settlement its chief source of wealth. Merchants were recorded here in the sixteenth century. In 1685 the nobleman Mihai Cantacuzino bought land at Slănic with the intention of exploiting its salt; a charter of 1691 confirmed his rights over the estate and a share of the salt extracted. In 1713 he gave the estate and mines to the Colțea monastery in Bucharest, linking the work of the salt miners to an ecclesiastical foundation.
simp_chinese: 斯勒尼克位于瓦拉几亚平原北方丘陵中，岩盐矿藏是聚落的主要财富来源。十六世纪的文献已记载当地商人。1685年，贵族米哈伊·坎塔库济诺购买斯勒尼克土地，打算开采盐矿；1691年的特许状确认了他对领地及部分所采盐的权利。1713年，他将领地和矿场赠予布加勒斯特的科尔采亚修院，使盐工的劳动与一座教会机构相联系。

english:
Ston lies at the entrance to the Peljesac Peninsula on the Dalmatian coast, where salt production and strategic geography made it valuable to the Republic of Ragusa. Salt pans supplied an important commodity and source of revenue, while the position helped control access between the peninsula and the mainland. Fortifications linked the settlement with nearby Mali Ston, creating one of the most distinctive defensive landscapes of the Adriatic.

Ragusa acquired Ston and the Pelješac peninsula in 1333 and developed the fortified towns of Ston and Mali Ston. Walls across the narrow entrance protected both the peninsula and valuable salt pans. Salt production connected local work with the revenue and commerce of the maritime republic.
simp_chinese:
斯通位于达尔马提亚海岸佩列沙茨半岛入口，盐业和战略地理使它对拉古萨共和国具有重要价值。盐田供应关键商品与财政收入，位置又帮助控制半岛和大陆之间的通行。城防把聚落同邻近小斯通联系起来，形成亚得里亚海最鲜明的防御景观之一。

拉古萨于1333年取得斯通和佩列沙茨半岛，随后建设斯通与小斯通两座设防城镇。横跨半岛狭窄入口的城墙保护土地及宝贵盐田。盐业将地方劳动同海上共和国的财政与商业联系起来。

english:
Slaný lies northwest of Prague on the road toward Saxony. Benedictines established a hospital and a church dedicated to Saint Gotthard here in 1136, and King Wenceslaus II granted the settlement town rights after 1295. Fire and an earthquake damaged the fortified town in the fourteenth century, but its position on the trade route encouraged its growth.

The Taborites captured Slaný in 1425 and held it until 1434. Their preachers counted it among the holy cities expected to survive the end of the world, while the Benedictine monks were forced to leave. The town later supported George of Poděbrady's election as king and received privileges from him. During the Bohemian Revolt it housed the family of Frederick V; after White Mountain, its new Catholic lords of the Martinic family built a Baroque church and monastery.
simp_chinese:
斯拉尼位于布拉格西北，处在通往萨克森的道路上。1136年，本笃会士在此建立医院和供奉圣哥达的教堂；1295年以后，瓦茨拉夫二世国王授予聚落城市权。十四世纪，一场地震和一场大火先后损坏设防城镇，但商路上的位置促进了它的发展。

1425年塔博尔派攻占斯拉尼，直到1434年才离开。他们的传教者将此地列为预期能在末世幸存的圣城之一，本笃会修士则被迫离去。城镇后来支持波杰布拉迪的伊日当选国王，并从他那里获得特权。波希米亚起义期间，腓特烈五世的家人曾居于此；白山战役后，新的天主教领主马尔蒂尼茨家族兴建巴洛克教堂与修道院。

english:
Slatina belongs to the Olt river country of Wallachia, where cultivated plains and river crossings connect local communities with wider southeastern European routes. Farming and livestock supply markets, while river access and roads provide opportunities for exchange. A regional center can gather products and services from surrounding villages. Seasonal water conditions influence movement, making dependable crossings and local knowledge important to both ordinary commerce and official travel.

A document issued by the Wallachian prince Vladislav I in 1368 mentions Slatina and exempts merchants from Brașov from customs duties there. The town's position on routes linking Transylvania and Wallachia gave its crossing and market a role in regional commerce. Later, Ottoman suzerainty shaped the principality's political relationships while local exchange continued.
simp_chinese:
斯拉蒂纳属于瓦拉几亚奥尔特河地区，耕作平原和渡口把地方社区连接到东南欧洲更广路线。农业牲畜向市场供货，河流道路提供交换机会。区域中心汇集周围村庄产品服务，季节水情影响移动，使可靠渡口地方知识对普通商业和官方旅行都重要。

瓦拉几亚君主弗拉迪斯拉夫一世于1368年颁布的文书提到斯拉蒂纳，并免除布拉索夫商人在此经过时的关税。城镇位于连接特兰西瓦尼亚和瓦拉几亚的路线，使渡口与市场参与区域贸易。后来奥斯曼宗主权影响公国的政治关系，地方交换仍持续进行。

english: Slavkovichi lies in the Pskov country between the Velikaya and the lands around Porkhov. The settlement was recorded in the cadastral books of 1585–1587 as a pogost, the center of the Slavkovskaya district of the Rozhnitsa area. Its setting belonged to the territory once governed by the Pskov Republic, which became part of the Grand Duchy of Moscow in 1510. By the time of the cadastral record, Slavkovichi served as a local center within the Russian state.
simp_chinese: 斯拉夫科维奇位于普斯科夫地区，介于韦利卡亚河和波尔霍夫一带之间。1585至1587年的土地登记簿将它记为一处波戈斯特，即罗日尼察地区斯拉夫科夫斯卡亚辖区的中心。这里曾属于普斯科夫共和国的领土，1510年随之归入莫斯科大公国。登记簿编写时，斯拉夫科维奇已是俄罗斯国家境内的地方中心。

english: Propoysk stands where the Pronya joins the Sozh, a river junction in the eastern lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The chronicles mention it in 1136 as Prupoy; later forms of the name included Proposhensk and Propolsk. It belonged to Mstsislaw Voivodeship under Lithuania and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. The Russo-Polish War of 1654–1667 badly damaged the town, which passed to Russia in the first partition of the Commonwealth in 1772.
simp_chinese: 普罗波伊斯克坐落在普罗尼亚河汇入索日河之处，位于立陶宛大公国东部的河流交汇地。编年史在1136年以普鲁波伊之名称及此地，后来的名称还包括普罗波申斯克和普罗波尔斯克。在立陶宛及波兰立陶宛联邦统治下，它属于姆斯季斯拉夫省。1654—1667年俄波战争使城镇遭受严重破坏；1772年联邦第一次被瓜分后，它归入俄罗斯。

english:
Sławno, historically known in German as Schlawe, is a Pomeranian town inland from the Baltic coast. In 1317 the Święca brothers granted New Sławno town rights under Lübeck law, distinguishing it from the older settlement to the north. Trade, crafts, farming and fishing supported its inhabitants, and town walls later enclosed the streets.

During the later Middle Ages and early modern period, Sławno formed part of a Pomeranian world of towns, dukes and rural estates. The Reformation changed religious life, and the Thirty Years' War disrupted the wider region. Later Brandenburg-Prussian rule placed the town in a different territorial state, while its markets and crafts continued to serve the surrounding country.
simp_chinese:
斯瓦夫诺，德语旧称施拉韦，是波罗的海内陆的一座波美拉尼亚城镇。1317年，希文察兄弟按照吕贝克法授予新斯瓦夫诺城市权利，使它与北面的旧聚落相区别。贸易、手工业、农业和捕鱼支持居民生计，后来城墙环绕街区。

中世纪晚期和近代早期，斯瓦夫诺处在由城镇、公爵和乡村庄园组成的波美拉尼亚世界中。宗教改革改变了宗教生活，三十年战争又扰乱了更广阔的地区。后来城镇进入勃兰登堡—普鲁士统治，其市场和手工业仍服务着周围乡村。

english: Slea Head marks the western end of the Dingle peninsula in Kerry, looking across a narrow stretch of water to the Blasket Islands. The headland and islands stand against the Atlantic swell, their cliffs and rocky shores offering little shelter to a vessel caught in rough weather. To the east lies Dingle Bay and the harbour of Dingle; farther west is open ocean. For sailors passing this coast the islands and the shape of the headland were useful landmarks, though currents and rocks demanded care close to shore.
simp_chinese: 斯莱角标示凯里丁格尔半岛的西端，隔着一段狭窄水域望向布拉斯基特群岛。岬角与岛屿迎着大西洋涌浪，悬崖和岩岸难以为遭遇恶劣天气的船只提供庇护。东面是丁格尔湾与丁格尔港，西面则是开阔大洋。对于经过这段海岸的水手，岛屿与岬角的轮廓是有用地标，但近岸的潮流和礁石也需要谨慎应对。

english:
Schleswig takes its name from the Schlei, the long inlet of the Baltic at whose western end it stands. Across the water lay Hedeby, a major Viking trading settlement. After repeated destruction in the eleventh century, its population moved to the opposite shore, where Schleswig developed as a town. Its cathedral, begun in 1138, served a bishopric established as early as 947.

In 1544 Gottorf Castle became the residence of the dukes of Gottorf, vassals of the Danish crown who ruled substantial lands in Schleswig and Holstein. Their seat made the town a centre of ducal government. The Great Northern War altered that position: in 1721 the dukes lost Gottorf and much of their territory, and the castle became part of the Danish crown lands.
simp_chinese:
石勒苏益格坐落在波罗的海狭长的施莱湾西端，城名也源于这条海湾。对岸曾是重要的维京贸易聚落海泽比。十一世纪屡遭破坏后，居民迁至北岸，石勒苏益格逐渐发展起来。主教座堂始建于1138年，服务于947年设立的主教区。

1544年，戈托尔夫城堡成为戈托尔夫公爵的居所。公爵是丹麦王室的封臣，统治石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因的大片土地；他们的驻节使这座城镇成为公国的行政中心。大北方战争改变了这一地位：1721年，公爵失去戈托尔夫及大部分领土，城堡转为丹麦王室领地的一部分。

english: The Slet̓éw̓si, or valley people, were a Kalispel group associated with the Colville Valley west of the Chewelah Mountains. Their neighbors along the Pend Oreille River gathered camas and fished in a country of rivers and wooded hills. In 1811 the fur trader David Thompson visited a Kalispel village on the Pend Oreille, passing a broad meadow known for its camas roots.
simp_chinese: 斯莱特维西意为“谷地之民”，是与奇韦拉山脉以西科尔维尔谷地有关的卡利斯佩尔人群体。他们在潘德奥雷伊河沿岸的邻人采集卡马斯、捕鱼，生活在河流与森林山丘之间。1811年，毛皮商人大卫·汤普森到访潘德奥雷伊河上的卡利斯佩尔村落，经过一片以卡马斯根茎闻名的广阔草甸。

english: The Tla'amin homeland embraces the mainland coast and nearby islands of the northern Salish Sea. Villages stood beside the sheltered waters and salmon streams; at tiskʷət, people gathered seasonally near the outlet of Powell Lake. Farther north, the winter village at Grace Harbour was shared with some Homalco and Klahoose families. Canoes carried people between these places, while fishing grounds, shellfish beds and forest resources supported life along the inlets and islands.
simp_chinese: 特拉阿明人的故土包括萨利什海北部的大陆海岸与附近岛屿。村落坐落在受庇护的水域和鲑鱼溪流旁；在蒂斯夸特，人们随季节聚集于鲍威尔湖的出水口附近。更靠北的格雷斯港冬季村落曾与部分霍马尔科及克拉胡斯家庭共用。独木舟载人往返各地，渔场、贝类产地和森林资源共同养育着海湾与岛屿上的居民。

english:
Sligo stands where the Garavogue River runs from Lough Gill toward the sea, commanding a crossing and a harbour on the coast of Connacht. An Anglo-Norman town grew here in the thirteenth century beside a castle and a Dominican friary. The O'Conors of Sligo later held the town, while the friary's carved tombs and altar reflected the patronage of local families.

Sligo's position made it a prize in the wars of the late sixteenth century. In 1595 Richard Bingham besieged the castle, then held by Hugh Roe O'Donnell's men, and the friary suffered damage in the fighting. During the next century's upheaval Sir Frederick Hamilton attacked the town and friary in 1642. Despite fire and war, the Dominican church and cloister remained a visible record of the town's medieval life.
simp_chinese:
斯莱戈坐落在加拉沃格河畔，河水从吉尔湖流向大海，这里扼守渡口与康诺特海岸上的港湾。十三世纪，一座盎格鲁—诺曼城镇在城堡与道明会修院旁兴起。斯莱戈的奥康纳家族后来掌控城镇，修院雕刻精美的墓碑和祭坛则反映了当地家族的赞助。

十六世纪末的战争中，斯莱戈因其位置成为争夺目标。1595年，理查德·宾厄姆围攻由休·罗·奥唐奈部下占据的城堡，修院也在战斗中受损。下个世纪的动乱中，弗雷德里克·汉密尔顿爵士于1642年袭击城镇与修院。尽管经历火灾和战争，道明会教堂与回廊仍见证着这座城镇的中世纪生活。

english:
Slite lies on Gotland's eastern coast, where small offshore islands shelter a natural harbour. Finds from an eleventh-century burial ground point to contacts across the Baltic, and the place is first mentioned in writing in the fourteenth century. Two medieval defensive works stood here; fighting took place around the castle in 1404, when the Teutonic Order held Gotland.

After the island became Swedish in 1645, plans were made to fortify Slite and make it a town. Work began on a fort on Enholmen in 1657 but stopped after a few years for lack of money. A redoubt was built on the mainland in 1662–1664. Later proposals for a carefully planned town also remained unrealised, although shipbuilding and lime-burning continued on a smaller scale around the harbour.
simp_chinese:
斯利特位于哥得兰东岸，近海小岛为天然港口提供庇护。一处十一世纪墓地的发现显示这里与波罗的海对岸有联系；地名首次见于十四世纪的文献。此地曾有两处中世纪防御工事；1404年，条顿骑士团控制哥得兰时，城堡附近发生战斗。

1645年岛屿归属瑞典后，政府计划加固斯利特并将其建成城镇。恩霍尔门岛上的堡垒于1657年动工，几年后因缺乏资金停工；1662至1664年，大陆一侧又建起一座棱堡。后来修建规划城镇的提议仍未实现，但港口周围继续有造船和烧石灰的活动。

english:
Sliven lies where the Stara Planina foothills open onto the plain of Zagore, below a rocky ridge with a medieval fortress. In the Second Bulgarian Empire, when Tsar Ivan Alexander ruled, it was a town on the Byzantine frontier ringed by twenty-four monasteries in the nearby hills. The Ottoman conquest destroyed the town and fortresses, and the monasteries were burned in 1388.

As Islimiye, the Ottomans made it the seat of a district from the early sixteenth century. In the seventeenth century its workshops turned out guns, pickaxes and iron tools, and a Jewish community grew; a traveller's notebook of 1668 singled the town out as a Jewish centre. The steep hills around it sheltered hajduk bands, and Sliven became known as the town of a hundred voivodes. Many of its men fought in the Greek rising of 1821 and the Serbian rising of 1804–13, among them Kondo Bimbashi, whose action helped take Belgrade fortress in 1806. After the Russo-Ottoman war of 1828–29 many people left, but in 1834 Dobri Zhelyazkov opened a cloth factory here, the first in Bulgaria.
simp_chinese:
斯利文位于斯塔拉山脉山麓与扎戈雷平原的交接处，岩石山脊下有一座中世纪堡垒。第二保加利亚帝国伊凡·亚历山大在位时，这里是拜占庭边境上的城镇，附近山中环绕着二十四座修道院。奥斯曼征服摧毁了城镇和堡垒，1388年修道院被焚毁。

奥斯曼人称这里为伊斯利姆耶，自十六世纪初起设为地区的中心。十七世纪，城里的作坊出产枪支、镐和铁制工具，犹太社群也不断壮大；1668年一位旅行者的笔记特别指出这里是犹太人的中心。四周陡峭的山地庇护着海杜克武装，斯利文因此被称为“百位首领之城”。许多斯利文人参加了1821年的希腊起义和1804至1813年的塞尔维亚起义，其中孔多·宾巴希的行动帮助起义军在1806年攻取了贝尔格莱德要塞。1828至1829年俄土战争后许多人离开，但1834年多布里·热利亚兹科夫在此开办了布厂，是保加利亚的第一家。

english:
Slobodskoy stands on a high bank of the Vyatka. Archaeological evidence points to early fortifications, and the settlement appears in a chronicle in 1489, when Moscow's army captured the Vyatka towns. A charter of 1505 announced the appointment of a new governor. Its wooden kremlin was protected by a steep bank, a ravine, ditches and an earthen rampart, while a separate fortified settlement housed many of the townspeople.

A charter of 1522 mentions streets and the yards maintained in the town by people from the surrounding country, including Udmurts and Tatars, for use during sieges. At the end of the sixteenth century a monastery was founded north of the settlement and became a separate defensive complex. Its wooden gateway tower, built in 1610, belonged to the network of buildings that guarded Slobodskoy and its approaches.
simp_chinese:
斯洛博茨科伊坐落在维亚特卡河高岸。考古证据显示这里早有防御工事；1489年莫斯科军队攻取维亚特卡诸城的编年史首次提到这座聚落。1505年的敕书宣布派遣新总督。木制克里姆林依靠陡峭河岸、沟谷、壕沟和土垒保护，许多居民住在另有围墙的居民区。

1522年的敕书提到城中街道，也记载周围地区的乌德穆尔特人和鞑靼人等在城里拥有院落，供围城时使用。十六世纪末，居民区以北建立修道院，形成独立的防御体系。1610年建成的木制门楼是保护斯洛博茨科伊及其门户的一组建筑之一。

english:
Slobozia belongs to the lowland country of southern Wallachia, where open plains and river routes supported farming and pastoral resources. Grain and livestock supplied households and regional markets, while local crafts and exchange added necessities. Settlement depended on water and transport across land that could be productive but exposed to seasonal drought, flood, or military movement. Roads linked communities with larger towns and Danubian connections.

A 1614 charter mentions the deserted village of Văideei, associated with present-day Slobozia. A monastery was established in the area in the early seventeenth century and rebuilt by the Wallachian ruler Matei Basarab around 1634. Subsequent rulers confirmed privileges intended to encourage settlement. The Ialomița valley also lay on routes connecting the plain with regional markets, placing religious patronage and commerce alongside the work of local households.
simp_chinese:
斯洛博齐亚属于瓦拉几亚南部低地，开阔平原和河流路线支持农业及牧业资源。粮食与牲畜供应家庭、地区市场，地方工艺和交换增加必需品。定居依靠水源及交通，土地虽能生产，也可能面对季节干旱、洪水或军队移动。道路连接较大城镇和多瑙河联系，居民生计与地区安全相互关联。

1614年的一份文书提到已经荒废的瓦伊代伊村，与今天的斯洛博齐亚相联系。十七世纪初这里建立修道院，瓦拉几亚统治者马泰·巴萨拉布约于1634年将其重建。后来的统治者确认了旨在鼓励居民定居的特权。雅洛米察河谷也处在连接平原与地区市场的道路上，宗教资助和商业同地方家庭劳动共同塑造了聚落。

english:
Slonim stands where the Isa joins the Shchara, a river that runs north towards the Neman. A wooden stronghold on the Shchara was recorded in the Middle Ages, and a town grew at the meeting of routes through the Lithuanian lands. It received town rights in 1532 and later became a regional centre of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

The statesman Lew Sapieha, starost of Slonim, secured the renewal of its privileges and a coat of arms incorporating his family's emblem. From 1631 to 1685 the town hosted the Lithuanian diet. In the eighteenth century Michał Kazimierz Ogiński encouraged its recovery after war, sponsoring a canal connecting the Shchara with the Dnieper basin. He also established an opera theatre, schools of music and ballet, and a printing house, bringing an ambitious court culture to the provincial town.
simp_chinese:
斯洛尼姆位于伊萨河汇入夏拉河之处，夏拉河向北流向涅曼河。中世纪文献记载河畔有一座木制堡寨，城镇在立陶宛诸地道路交会处发展起来。1532年，斯洛尼姆获得城市权利，后来成为波兰立陶宛联邦的地区中心。

斯洛尼姆地方长官、政治家莱夫·萨皮哈促成城镇特权的更新，并取得包含家族徽记的城徽。1631至1685年，立陶宛议会在此召开。十八世纪，米哈乌·卡齐米日·奥金斯基推动战后复兴，资助开凿连接夏拉河与第聂伯河水系的运河。他还创办歌剧院、音乐与芭蕾学校及印刷所，将雄心勃勃的宫廷文化带到这座地方城镇。

english: Sloop Harbour Point marks the northeastern end of Brig Harbour Island on the Labrador coast, near the waters of Groswater Bay. Here a chain of islands and inlets lies between the mainland and the open Labrador Sea. Inuit communities travelled and hunted along this coast, exchanging marine products with European visitors. During the eighteenth century the Labrador fishery expanded as vessels came north for cod, while merchants also sought salmon, sealskins and oil.
simp_chinese: 斯卢普港角位于拉布拉多海岸布里格港岛的东北端，靠近格罗斯沃特湾水域。这里岛屿与海湾相连，横亘在大陆和开阔的拉布拉多海之间。因纽特社群沿海岸旅行狩猎，并与欧洲来客交换海产品。十八世纪，越来越多船只北上捕鳕，拉布拉多渔业随之扩大；商人也收购鲑鱼、海豹皮与海豹油。

english: Sloten, or Sleat in Frisian, is a fortified town in the lake country of Friesland. It grew in the thirteenth century beside a fortified house of the Van Harinxma family. Its town rights are recorded in a charter of 1426. A waterway from Sneek to the former Zuiderzee crossed a road toward Stavoren here, making Sloten a useful place to collect tolls and control traffic. During the struggle for Friesland, the town fell in 1523 after a siege in which Frisian and Gelderland troops defended it. Its strategic position remained valuable in the Eighty Years' War, when an attempted surprise attack using men concealed in a beer ship failed.
simp_chinese: 斯洛滕的弗里斯兰语名为斯莱特，是弗里斯兰湖区的一座设防小城。十三世纪，它在范哈尔因赫斯马家族的设防宅邸旁发展起来；1426年的文书记载了它的城市权利。从斯内克通往旧须德海的水道在此与通往斯塔福伦的道路交叉，使城镇成为征收通行税和控制交通的有利地点。1523年争夺弗里斯兰的战争中，驻守的弗里斯兰和海尔德兰军队围城后失守。八十年战争期间，这里的战略位置仍然重要；一次将士兵藏在运啤酒船中、试图突袭城镇的计划未能成功。

english: Gradec, later known as Slovenj Gradec, lies in the Mislinja valley in the southeastern Alps. Its name, meaning a small castle in Slovene, appears in a deed of 1091. It belonged to the Duchy of Styria from 1180, and the noble Windisch-Graetz family took its name from this place. The parish church of Saint Elizabeth was recorded in 1235; beside it stands a Gothic chapel of the Holy Spirit with mid-fifteenth-century frescoes. German and Slovene names reflect the town's place within the multilingual lands of the Habsburgs, while its church served communities in the surrounding valley.
simp_chinese: 格拉代茨后来称斯洛文尼格拉代茨，位于阿尔卑斯东南部的米斯林亚河谷。地名在斯洛文尼亚语中意为“小城堡”，见于1091年的文书。1180年起，这里属于施蒂里亚公国，温迪施格雷茨贵族家族也以此地为名。圣伊丽莎白教区教堂见于1235年的记载，旁边的哥特式圣灵小堂保存着十五世纪中叶的壁画。德语与斯洛文尼亚语名称反映了城镇在哈布斯堡多语言地区中的位置；教堂则服务周围河谷的居民。

english:
Sloviansk grew beside the saline lakes of Tor in the Siverskyi Donets basin. Long before it received its later name, people came to the lakes to boil salt, a valuable resource on the edge of the steppe. The salt works and the fortifications built to protect them gave rise to a permanent settlement.

Ukrainian migrants established a fort at Maiak Lake in 1663. Under its protection, state salt production began at Tor in 1664, and a fortress was built beside the salt lakes in 1676. Tor became a company town of the Izium Cossack regiment in 1685. Salt boiling ended in 1782 as cheaper Crimean salt competed with the local product. Two years later Tor became a district town and was renamed Slovensk, the forerunner of Sloviansk.
simp_chinese:
斯洛维安斯克兴起于北顿涅茨河流域的托尔盐湖旁。在它获得后来的名字之前，人们便来到湖边煮盐；这种资源在草原边缘十分珍贵。盐场和保护盐场的防御工事促成了永久聚落的形成。

1663年，乌克兰移民在马亚克湖建立堡垒。托尔的官办盐业于1664年在堡垒保护下开始，1676年，盐湖附近又建起一座堡垒。1685年，托尔成为伊久姆哥萨克团的百人队驻地。随着更便宜的克里米亚盐与当地产品竞争，煮盐业于1782年停止。两年后，托尔成为县城并改名斯洛文斯克，这是斯洛维安斯克名称的前身。

english:
Slunj stands above the Slunjčica, near its meeting with the Korana. The castle of the Frankopan lords guarded one bank, while a settlement and fortified Franciscan monastery stood across the water. At nearby Rastoke, the Slunjčica divides into channels and falls before joining the Korana; its waters turned mills that served the surrounding country.

In the division of the Frankopan estates in 1449, Slunj became the seat of a branch of the family. Its position exposed it to Ottoman raids, and after the Slunj line died out in 1572 it became part of the Military Frontier. The town and monastery suffered destruction during the wars, and Slunj remained a border fort even after peace was made in 1699. In the early nineteenth century French rule brought new roads, bridges and military stores; a frontier road through Rastoke followed in 1825.
simp_chinese:
斯卢尼位于斯卢尼奇察河上方，靠近它与科拉纳河的交汇处。弗兰科潘领主的城堡守护着一岸，对岸则有聚落和设防的方济各会修道院。附近的拉斯托凯一带，斯卢尼奇察河分成多条水道，形成瀑布后汇入科拉纳河；河水驱动的磨坊为周围地区服务。

1449年弗兰科潘家族分割领地时，斯卢尼成为其中一个支系的驻地。当地容易遭受奥斯曼袭击；1572年斯卢尼支系绝嗣后，这里被纳入军事边疆。城镇和修道院在战争中遭到破坏，1699年议和之后，斯卢尼仍是一座边防堡垒。十九世纪初的法国统治带来了新道路、桥梁和军用仓库；1825年，一条边疆道路又穿过拉斯托凯。

english:
Słupsk stands on the Słupia River in Pomerania. The town's authorities acquired the coastal village of Ustka in 1337 and developed a port there, linking the inland town with Baltic trade. From 1368 to 1478 Słupsk was a ducal residence. Duke Casimir IV became a Polish vassal in 1374, and later dukes also paid homage to Polish kings; in 1478 the territory returned to the wider Duchy of Pomerania.

Reformation preaching reached the town in 1521, and its inhabitants gradually adopted Lutheranism amid conflict over churches and clergy. Following the Thirty Years' War, the peace settlements of 1648 and 1653 placed it under Brandenburg. The town lost much of its earlier importance, although its economy later stabilized. In 1807 Polish troops took it during the Napoleonic wars, and in 1815 it became part of Prussia's Province of Pomerania.
simp_chinese:
斯武普斯克位于波美拉尼亚的斯武皮亚河畔。1337年，城镇当局购入海滨的乌斯特卡村并在那里发展港口，使内陆城镇与波罗的海贸易相连。1368至1478年间，斯武普斯克是公爵驻地。公爵卡齐米日四世于1374年成为波兰的封臣，后继公爵也向波兰国王宣誓效忠；1478年，领地重新并入更广阔的波美拉尼亚公国。

1521年，宗教改革的宣讲传入城镇；教堂与神职人员受到冲击，居民逐渐转向路德宗。三十年战争后，1648及1653年的和平安排使此地归属勃兰登堡。城镇失去往日的许多重要地位，经济后来逐渐稳定。拿破仑战争期间，波兰军队于1807年占领此地；1815年它成为普鲁士波美拉尼亚省的一部分。

english:
Slutsk stands on the Sluch and was the capital of a separate principality from the twelfth century. Under the Grand Duchy of Lithuania it became a private town of the Olelkovich and later Radziwiłł families. Its strong fortifications, churches and market made it an important centre in the country south of Minsk. Casimir IV granted it Magdeburg rights in 1441.

The Radziwiłłs made Slutsk a centre of the Reformed Church, with a gymnasium serving its Protestant community. Jewish residents are recorded by the late sixteenth century, and Scottish immigrants also settled in the town in the seventeenth. Slutsk became especially renowned for the rich woven sashes worn by Commonwealth nobles over the żupan. Their fame was such that similar garments made elsewhere were also called Slutsk belts. The town became a county seat in 1778 and passed to Russia in the Second Partition of 1793.
simp_chinese:
斯卢茨克位于斯卢奇河畔，自十二世纪起曾是一个独立公国的首府。在立陶宛大公国治下，它成为奥列尔科维奇、后来又成为拉齐维乌家族的私人城镇。坚固的防御工事、教堂与市场，使其成为明斯克以南的重要中心。1441年，卡齐米日四世授予城镇马格德堡法。

拉齐维乌家族使斯卢茨克成为归正宗中心，并为新教社群设立文法学校。十六世纪末已有犹太居民的记载，十七世纪苏格兰移民也在此定居。斯卢茨克尤其以华丽的织造腰带闻名，联邦贵族将其系在长袍外面。这种腰带声名远扬，以至别处制作的同类织品也被称为斯卢茨克腰带。1778年，城镇成为县治；1793年第二次瓜分后，它归属俄国。

english: Slyne Head lies at the western edge of Connemara, where a chain of low islands and rocks extends into the Atlantic. Ships approaching Galway Bay from the north must pass this exposed coast, with its reefs and channels made dangerous by weather and swell. As Galway's trade grew in the early nineteenth century, merchants and mariners sought better lights on the western approaches. Two towers were built on an island off Slyne Head and lit in 1836, marking the hazardous coast for vessels making their way toward the bay.
simp_chinese: 斯莱恩角位于康尼马拉西缘，一列低矮岛屿与礁石从此伸入大西洋。船只从北方驶向戈尔韦湾时须经过这段无遮蔽海岸，天气和涌浪使礁石及水道更加危险。十九世纪初，随着戈尔韦贸易增长，商人和水手要求改善西部入口的灯标。1836年，斯莱恩角外海一座岛上的两座灯塔点亮，为驶向海湾的船只标示险岸。

english:
Slyudyanka lies at the southern end of Lake Baikal, where streams descend from the wooded Khamar-Daban mountains to the shore. Its name recalls the mica found in the district. Russian expeditions reached this part of the lake in the seventeenth century, when a small fortified post was established nearby; the precise position and history of that early post remain matters of debate.

In 1802 settlers established winter quarters at Slyudyanka and revived the extraction of mica. At the nearby village of Kultuk, a road across the Khamar-Daban was begun at the end of the eighteenth century. It offered a land route around the southern end of Baikal, although the mountain crossing was difficult. The lake shore thus became a meeting place of mineral extraction and travel between Irkutsk and the country east of Baikal.
simp_chinese:
斯柳江卡位于贝加尔湖南端，溪流从林木覆盖的哈马尔达坂山脉流向湖岸。地名让人想起当地出产的云母。俄国探险队在十七世纪抵达这段湖岸，并在附近建立小型设防据点；早期据点的位置和沿革仍有争议。

1802年，移民在斯柳江卡建立冬营地，重新开采云母。附近的库尔图克村在十八世纪末开始修建穿越哈马尔达坂的道路。尽管翻山艰难，这条道路仍为绕行贝加尔湖南端提供了陆路。湖岸因此成为矿物开采与伊尔库茨克、贝加尔湖以东地区之间交通的交会之地。

sources.title: Gen skh IO Slyudyanskoe GP TOM 1 KHarakteristika.pdf

english:
Sm’álgyax is the language of the Coast Tsimshian, whose communities live among the mouths of the Skeena and Nass rivers and the channels of the northern coast. Their houses held names, territories and fishing rights, while alliances and marriages joined the communities of this maritime country. Salmon and other coastal foods supported villages connected by canoe routes and trade.

By the 1790s foreign ships were coming to the coast for sea otter pelts. Legex, a line of Gispaxlo’ots chiefs, controlled access to trade and levied fees for safe passage. In 1834 the Hudson’s Bay Company moved Fort Simpson to Lax Kw’alaams, an old camping place held by Legex. Tsimshian families gathered near the post, and its trade depended on the relationships and seasonal movements of the people whose land it occupied.
simp_chinese:
斯马尔吉亚克斯是沿海齐姆希安人的语言，他们的社群居住在斯基纳河、纳斯河口及北方海岸水道之间。家屋拥有名称、土地和捕鱼权，联盟与婚姻则将这片海洋地区的社群联系起来。鲑鱼和其他沿海食物供养村庄，独木舟航线与贸易连接各处。

到十八世纪九十年代，外国船只为海獭皮来到海岸。吉斯帕克斯洛茨人的世袭首领莱盖克斯控制贸易通道，为安全通行征取费用。1834年，哈德逊湾公司将辛普森堡迁至莱盖克斯拥有的一处古老营地拉克斯夸拉姆斯。齐姆希安家庭聚居在据点附近，堡垒的贸易依赖这片土地上居民的关系和季节性迁徙。

english: Smai Samkai is a medieval burial site in the central Kazakh steppe, near the uplands south of the Nura. Its mausoleum belongs to a landscape rich in older monuments: stone burial structures of the Bronze Age stand elsewhere among the hills of central Kazakhstan. Across this open country, graves and memorial buildings marked places of remembrance for successive communities over many centuries.
simp_chinese: 斯迈萨姆凯是中央哈萨克草原上的中世纪墓地，位于努拉河以南高地附近。这里的陵墓坐落在一片古迹众多的地区，中央哈萨克丘陵的其他地方还留有青铜时代的石构墓葬。在这片开阔土地上，墓地和纪念建筑历经多个世纪，为不同时代的群体标示凭吊之所。

sources.title: Памятники истории и культуры местного значения Шетского района

english: The Small Balkhan is a dry mountain ridge at the western edge of the Karakum, between the Great Balkhan and the western spurs of the Kopet Dag. Rocky slopes rise above the surrounding desert to a high plateau and low peaks. Desert vegetation gives way to more substantial mountain steppe on the heights, where plants find a foothold amid the sparse soil and stone. Together the two Balkhan ranges form conspicuous landmarks in the arid country east of the Caspian Sea.
simp_chinese: 小巴尔罕山是卡拉库姆沙漠西缘的一条干燥山脉，位于大巴尔罕山和科佩特山西部支脉之间。岩石山坡从周围沙漠中升起，形成高原和低矮山峰。高处的山地草原植被比荒漠更为丰富，植物在稀薄的土壤和岩石间扎根。大、小巴尔罕两条山脉共同构成里海以东干旱地区醒目的地标。

english: The Mar Pequeno, or Little Sea, is a sheltered tidal channel in the Iguape–Cananéia estuary of southern São Paulo. Islands and sandy barriers separate its waters from the Atlantic, while mangroves grow along the muddy margins. The channel forms part of a wider network of estuaries and lagoons, where fresh water and tides meet and fish and waterbirds find feeding and breeding grounds.
simp_chinese: 小海是圣保罗南部伊瓜佩—卡纳内亚河口地区一条受掩护的潮汐水道。岛屿与沙质屏障将其水域与大西洋分开，泥泞岸边生长着红树林。这条水道属于更广阔的河口与潟湖网络，淡水和潮汐在此交汇，为鱼类与水鸟提供觅食和繁殖场所。

english: Smalyavichy stands on the Plisa, a tributary of the Berezina, in the forested country east of Minsk. In the sixteenth century it was held by Konstanty Ostrogski, Grand Hetman of Lithuania, before passing to the Radziwiłł family. The history of the settlement is bound to the great estates of these magnates. During Napoleon's invasion of Russia in 1812, military warehouses were established in the town, bringing the campaign's demands to its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 斯莫列维奇位于明斯克以东的林地，坐落在别列津纳河支流普利萨河畔。16世纪，这里属于立陶宛大盖特曼康斯坦蒂·奥斯特罗格斯基，后来转入拉齐维乌家族之手。这处聚落的历史与这些大贵族的庄园紧密相连。1812年拿破仑入侵俄罗斯期间，军队在镇上设立仓库，战争的需求也随之来到当地居民身边。

english: Smara lies beside the Saguia el-Hamra, an intermittent watercourse crossing the western Sahara towards the Atlantic. The wadi passes through dry country where water and vegetation are concentrated along its bed. Before the growth of a town, this was a meeting place for travellers and pastoral communities crossing the desert. The Saguia el-Hamra continues west towards Laayoune, linking the interior with the coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 斯马拉位于萨基亚哈姆拉河旁，这条间歇性河流横穿撒哈拉西部，流向大西洋。河道穿过干旱地区，水分和植被集中在河床附近。城镇兴起之前，这里就是穿越沙漠的旅人与游牧群体聚集之处。萨基亚哈姆拉河继续向西流往阿尤恩，将内陆与沿海平原联系起来。

english:
Smederevo stands at the meeting of the Jezava and the Danube, beneath the walls of one of the great fortresses of medieval Serbia. Its triangular enclosure and massive towers were built for Despot Đurađ Branković, who made the town his capital. The river protected the fortress on one side and placed the Serbian court close to the Hungarian frontier.

After Branković was obliged to surrender Belgrade to Hungary in 1427, work began on a new seat at Smederevo. The fortified palace was completed around 1430, and a larger walled town followed. The Ottomans captured Smederevo in 1439, but the Serbian Despotate was restored in 1444. Its final surrender in 1459 marked the end of the medieval Serbian state. The Ottomans made the town an administrative centre of the Smederevo sanjak, a role it held until their capture of Belgrade in 1521.
simp_chinese:
斯梅代雷沃坐落在耶扎瓦河与多瑙河的交汇处，城墙属于中世纪塞尔维亚最宏大的堡垒之一。专制公久拉吉·布兰科维奇下令修建三角形城垣与巨大塔楼，并以此为都。多瑙河护卫着堡垒一侧，也使塞尔维亚宫廷靠近匈牙利边境。

1427年，布兰科维奇依照先前的约定将贝尔格莱德交还匈牙利，随后开始在斯梅代雷沃营建新都。设防的宫廷约于1430年建成，规模更大的外城也随之兴建。奥斯曼人于1439年攻占此地，塞尔维亚专制公国在1444年复国。1459年，斯梅代雷沃最终投降，标志着中世纪塞尔维亚国家的终结。奥斯曼人将城镇设为斯梅代雷沃桑贾克的行政中心，直到1521年攻取贝尔格莱德。

english: Smerdyn was a church centre in the forested country of Novgorod’s Bezhetskaya district. Its earliest known mention is in a birch-bark petition, dated between 1396 and 1422, from the peasants of Smerdyn to the boyar Mikhail Yuryevich. In 1545 the Novgorod survey recorded the Nikolsky pogost of Smerdyn as the centre of a district, with four households. A stone Church of the Sign was built at the churchyard in 1835, adding a new building to the old rural centre.
simp_chinese: 斯梅尔登是诺夫哥罗德别热茨克区森林地带的一处教堂中心。已知最早记载见于1396至1422年间的一封桦树皮请愿书，斯梅尔登农民在信中向贵族米哈伊尔·尤里耶维奇陈情。1545年的诺夫哥罗德调查记载，斯梅尔登圣尼古拉教堂村是当地辖区中心，有四户人家。1835年，教堂村修建了一座石造圣母圣兆教堂，为这处古老的乡村中心增添了新建筑。

english: Smila lies near the Tiasmyn River in the lands west of the Dnieper. A settlement was established here by the early 1540s on land granted to the Cherkasy noble Yasko Tymkevych. In 1648 Smila became a company centre of the Chyhyryn Cossack regiment. The Lubomirski family acquired the estate in 1722; during the Koliivshchyna of 1768 rebels captured the town and destroyed its castle. Smila received Magdeburg rights in 1773 and passed to Russia in 1793.
simp_chinese: 斯米拉位于第聂伯河以西、佳斯明河附近。到1540年代初，切尔卡瑟贵族亚斯科·蒂姆凯维奇在获赐的土地上建立了居民点。1648年，斯米拉成为奇希林哥萨克团的百人队驻地。卢博米尔斯基家族于1722年取得地产；1768年科利伊夫希纳起义期间，起义者攻占城镇并摧毁城堡。斯米拉于1773年获得马格德堡法权，1793年转归俄国。

english: Smoky Bay lies on the western Eyre Peninsula, where shallow waters and islands face the Great Australian Bight. Its sandy shores and tidal flats meet dry inland country. In 1802 Matthew Flinders sailed along this coast in the Investigator, charting bays and islands already known to Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 烟湾位于艾尔半岛西部，浅水和岛屿面向大澳大利亚湾。沙岸与潮滩和干旱内陆相接。1802年，马修·弗林德斯乘“调查者”号沿此海岸航行，测绘原住民社群早已熟悉的海湾和岛屿。

english:
Smolensk stands on both banks of the upper Dnieper, on the old route from the Varangians to the Greeks, where boats were hauled from the Baltic rivers into the Dnieper. It was the seat of one of the strongest Rus' principalities, and its Svirskaya church of 1197 was admired as the finest building east of Kiev. The Mongols spared the city in 1240, but it paid tribute to the Horde and drifted into the orbit of Lithuania. When the Black Death struck in 1387, only five inhabitants are said to have survived, who walked out of the town and shut the gates behind them.

Vytautas of Lithuania won Smolensk in 1395 by spreading word that he marched against the Tatars; he took it back in 1404, after Oleg of Ryazan had briefly restored Prince Yury Svyatoslavich in 1401. The townspeople rose against Lithuanian rule in 1440, in the rising called the Great Turmoil. Muscovite sieges failed in 1502 and 1513, but Vasily III took the city in 1514 and founded Moscow's Novodevichy Convent in honour of the Smolensk icon of the Mother of God.

Fyodor Kon, master builder of Boris Godunov, raised a brick wall 6.5 km long around Smolensk between 1595 and 1602. It held out for some twenty months in 1609–11, under the voivode Mikhail Shein, before Sigismund III's army took the city; the Truce of Deulino left it to the Commonwealth. Shein came back in 1632 to besiege the city and surrendered in 1634, and Tsar Alexei finally retook the city on 23 September 1654.
simp_chinese:
斯摩棱斯克坐落在第聂伯河上游两岸，位于「从瓦良格人到希腊人」的古商路上，船只在这里被拖运，从波罗的海水系转入第聂伯河。它是罗斯最强大的公国之一的都城，1197年建成的斯维尔斯卡亚教堂被誉为基辅以东最美的建筑。1240年蒙古人放过了这座城，但它要向金帐汗国纳贡，并逐渐倒向立陶宛。1387年黑死病袭来，据说只剩五名居民幸存，他们走出城门，随手关上了城门。

1395年，立陶宛的维托夫特散布消息说自己是去攻打鞑靼人，趁机夺取了斯摩棱斯克；1401年梁赞的奥列格曾短暂扶植尤里·斯维亚托斯拉维奇复位，维托夫特又在1404年夺回此城。1440年，市民起事反抗立陶宛统治，史称「大动乱」。莫斯科人1502年和1513年的围攻均告失败，1514年瓦西里三世终于攻克此城，并在莫斯科创建新圣母修道院，以纪念斯摩棱斯克圣母像。

鲍里斯·戈东诺夫的营造师费奥多尔·孔于1595至1602年在斯摩棱斯克周围筑起一道长6.5公里的砖墙。1609至1611年，在总督米哈伊尔·沙因的指挥下，城池坚守约二十个月，之后才被西吉斯蒙德三世的军队攻克；《杰乌利诺停战协定》使其归属波兰立陶宛。沙因于1632年重返攻城，1634年投降；1654年9月23日，阿列克谢沙皇重新夺回此城。

english: Smolenskoye was founded in 1759 in the northern foothills of the Altai as a settlement of retired Cossacks and other Russian servicemen. Its early inhabitants came from several Siberian garrisons, including Tomsk, Tara, Krasnoyarsk and Tobolsk. A redoubt was built by the settlers, who named it for an icon they revered. In the nineteenth century the old route towards Mongolia passed through the village and encouraged trade.
simp_chinese: 斯摩棱斯科耶于1759年建在阿尔泰山北麓，最初是退役哥萨克和其他俄国军役人员的聚落。早期居民来自托木斯克、塔拉、克拉斯诺亚尔斯克和托博尔斯克等西伯利亚驻防地。定居者修建了一座以所敬奉圣像命名的棱堡。十九世纪，通往蒙古的旧道经过村庄，促进了当地贸易。

english: Smolyan lies among the forests and steep valleys of the central Rhodopes, along the Cherna River. The surrounding mountain district was for a time under the fourteenth-century lord Momchil before it came under Ottoman rule. In 1519 lands in the central Rhodopes were granted to the court physician Ahi Çelebi, whose name became associated with the district. Ottoman documents of the seventeenth century mention a settlement here as Ezerovo; neighbouring Raykovo and Ustovo developed as separate communities in the same mountain valley.
simp_chinese: 斯莫梁位于罗多彼山中部的森林与陡峭河谷之间，沿切尔纳河分布。十四世纪，周围山区曾一度处于领主莫姆奇尔统治下，后来归入奥斯曼帝国。1519年，罗多彼山中部的土地获赐宫廷医师阿希·切莱比，他的名字后来与这一地区联系起来。十七世纪的奥斯曼文献将此处一座聚落称为埃泽罗沃；附近的赖科沃和乌斯托沃则在同一山谷中作为独立聚落发展。

english:
One of the ancient cities of the Aegean coast, Smyrna was among the sites that claimed the honor of Homer's birth and later became one of the Seven Churches of Asia Minor addressed in the Book of Revelation. Under Byzantine rule it served as a major port linking the rich Anatolian hinterland to Aegean commerce, its harbor frequented by Venetian and Genoese merchants who established trading colonies along its wharves. In the late 13th and early 14th centuries the city passed between Byzantine, Genoese, and Aydinid Turkish hands in quick succession, its exceptional position making it a prize that no power in the Aegean could afford to ignore.

By the 1330s Umur Bey of the Aydinids held both the fortress on Mount Pagos and the harbour castle below, and his fleets sailed from Smyrna to raid across the Aegean. In 1344 a crusade coordinated by Pope Clement VI seized the harbour castle in a surprise attack, and for nearly sixty years the Knights of St John held the waterfront while the Turks held the heights. Timur ended the standoff in 1402, destroying the city and massacring most of its Christian majority; the Ottomans returned in 1415 and took full control when the last Aydinid bey died in 1426.

The Ottoman town was small, with barely three hundred adult men on record in 1530. Its rise came with the cotton of the hinterland, which from the late 16th century drew French, English, Dutch and Venetian traders. The French moved their consulate here from Chios in 1619 and the English in 1621, and the long war for Crete made Smyrna the army's supply port. Neither the plague of 1676 nor the earthquake of 1688 checked it, and by the end of the 17th century some 90,000 people lived here, Turks, Greeks, Armenians and Jews alongside the European merchants of the quays.
simp_chinese:
作为爱琴海沿岸的古老城市之一，士麦那曾与许多地点争夺荷马诞生地的荣誉，后来成为《启示录》中提及的小亚细亚七教会之一。在拜占庭统治下，它成为连接富庶的安纳托利亚腹地与爱琴海商业的主要港口，威尼斯和热那亚商人沿码头建立了许多贸易殖民地。在13世纪末和14世纪初，这座城市在拜占庭、热那亚和艾登王朝土耳其人之间迅速易手，其优越的地理位置使其成为爱琴海地区任何强权都无法忽视的战利品。

到14世纪30年代，艾登王朝的乌穆尔贝伊已同时占有帕戈斯山上的要塞和山下的港口城堡，他的舰队从士麦那出发，在爱琴海上四处袭掠。1344年，教宗克莱孟六世组织的十字军突袭夺下港口城堡，此后近六十年里，圣约翰骑士团守着水边，突厥人守着高处，相持不下。1402年帖木儿打破了这个僵局，他摧毁全城，屠杀了占居民多数的基督徒；1415年奥斯曼人重返，1426年最后一位艾登贝伊去世后，城市完全归于奥斯曼。

奥斯曼时代初期的士麦那只是个小镇，1530年登记在册的成年男子不过三百人。它的兴起靠的是腹地的棉花：16世纪后期起，法国、英国、荷兰和威尼斯商人纷纷到来。法国在1619年、英国在1621年把领事馆从希俄斯岛迁到这里，漫长的克里特战争又让士麦那成了大军的补给港。1676年的瘟疫和1688年的地震都没能拖住它，到17世纪末，城中已有约9万人，突厥人、希腊人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人，与码头上的欧洲商人比邻而居。

english: The Snare lakes lie in Tłı̨chǫ country along the river's lower course. Near Strutt Lake, the Snare passes through Slemon and Russell lakes on its way to Marian Lake; the latter is joined to the North Arm of Great Slave Lake by Frank Channel. Lake trout, whitefish and northern pike live in the Snare basin, among rocky uplands and patches of pine and birch forest.
simp_chinese: 斯内尔湖群位于特里乔人的土地上，沿斯内尔河下游分布。在斯特拉特湖附近，河水穿过斯莱蒙湖和拉塞尔湖，流向玛丽安湖；玛丽安湖又经弗兰克水道与大奴湖的北汊相连。斯内尔流域有湖红点鲑、白鲑和北狗鱼，周围是岩石高地，以及成片的松林和桦林。

Snare Hydro - WL Renewal Application - Engagement Log - Jul 10 23.pdf

english:
Snåsa lies near the northeastern end of Lake Snåsavatnet, where the settled valley meets the forests and mountains of inland Trøndelag. Its stone church has medieval origins, with the oldest parts dating back many centuries, and was recorded among the principal churches of the district after the Reformation. The surrounding country was also part of the homeland of the Southern Sámi.

The church was mentioned in Archbishop Olav Engelbrektsson's land register in 1533 and named the main church of its parish in 1589. In the eighteenth century the missionary Thomas von Westen travelled among the Sámi on behalf of the Danish-Norwegian mission. At Krossgården in Snåsa in 1723, he collected eight Sámi drums, objects associated with religious practices that the mission sought to suppress.
simp_chinese:
斯诺萨位于斯诺萨湖东北端附近，定居的谷地在此与特伦德拉格内陆的森林山地相接。当地石教堂始建于中世纪，最古老的部分已有数百年历史；宗教改革后它仍是这一地区的主要教堂之一。周围的土地也是南萨米人的故乡。

教堂见于大主教奥拉夫·恩格尔布雷克特松1533年的土地登记簿，1589年被列为本教区的主教堂。十八世纪，传教士托马斯·冯·韦斯滕受丹麦—挪威传教机构派遣，在萨米人中活动。1723年他在斯诺萨的克罗斯戈登收走八面萨米鼓；这些鼓与传教活动试图压制的宗教习俗相关。

english: Sniatyn stands on the Prut in Pokuttia, the borderland between Galicia and Moldavia. First mentioned in the historical record in 1158, the old town takes its name from Kostiantyn Stroslavich, a boyar and commander of Prince Yaroslav Osmomysl of Halych. Its place on the river put it on the approaches to the Carpathian foothills. The town received Magdeburg rights in 1448. Armenian inhabitants are recorded from the fifteenth century, and in 1628 King Sigismund III authorised an Armenian commune here. Sniatyn passed to the Habsburg monarchy in 1772.
simp_chinese: 斯尼亚廷坐落在普鲁特河畔，位于加利西亚与摩尔达维亚之间的波库季亚边地。它首见于1158年的记载，名字源自哈雷奇公爵雅罗斯拉夫·奥斯莫梅斯尔麾下的波雅尔和指挥官康斯坦丁·斯特罗斯拉维奇。1448年，城镇获得马格德堡法权。十五世纪的记载中已有亚美尼亚居民；1628年，齐格蒙特三世国王批准在此建立亚美尼亚人社群。1772年，斯尼亚廷转归哈布斯堡君主国。

english: At the head of Slocan Lake lies Snk'mip, a wetland in the mountain country of the Sinixt. An ancient village stood here, close to the lake and the streams that feed it. The Sinixt homeland extends through the upper Columbia region, where waterways connect valleys separated by forested mountains. Fish, game, and plants from the surrounding country sustained communities through the changing seasons.
simp_chinese: 斯洛坎湖北端的森克米普是一片湿地，坐落在西尼克斯人的山地家园之中。这里曾有一座古老村落，靠近湖泊及注入湖中的溪流。西尼克斯人的土地延伸至哥伦比亚河上游地区，水道连接着森林山岭分隔的各处河谷。周围的鱼、猎物和植物伴随季节变化，滋养当地社群。

english: The Snohomish lived along the river of the same name and among the shores and islands of Puget Sound. Their villages were linked by canoe routes, kinship, and alliances with neighboring peoples. Early in the nineteenth century, smallpox and measles brought heavy losses. In 1824 the Snohomish met the Hudson's Bay Company trader John Work, and later traded at Fort Nisqually on the southern sound.
simp_chinese: 斯诺霍米什人生活在同名河流沿岸，以及普吉特湾的海岸和岛屿之间。独木舟航线、亲族关系与同邻族的联盟连接着他们的村落。19世纪初，天花和麻疹使当地人口遭受重大损失。1824年，斯诺霍米什人遇见哈德逊湾公司商人约翰·沃克，后来也在海湾南部的尼斯阔利堡进行贸易。

english: Snovsk was a fortified town above the Snov River, north of Chernihiv, later known as Sedniv. The chronicle first records it in 1068, when Prince Sviatoslav of Chernihiv defeated a much larger Cuman force nearby. The river and its high bank gave the settlement a strong position in the Severian lands. In the Cossack Hetmanate, Sedniv became a company centre of the Chernihiv regiment.
simp_chinese: 斯诺夫斯克是切尔尼戈夫以北、斯诺夫河高岸上的设防城镇，后来称为谢德尼夫。编年史首于1068年记载此地，当时切尔尼戈夫的斯维亚托斯拉夫公爵在附近击败人数多得多的库曼军。河流和高岸为这座谢韦里亚居民点提供了有利的位置。在哥萨克酋长国时期，谢德尼夫成为切尔尼戈夫团的百人队驻地。

english: Snowbird Lake is a broad northern lake lying below the tree line, surrounded by spruce forest. It belongs to the headwaters of the Kazan River system, whose waters continue north through Kasba and other large lakes towards Baker Lake. Farther downstream the forest gives way to the open tundra of the barren grounds. Dene hunters from the southern lake country have travelled into this wider region in pursuit of caribou.
simp_chinese: 雪鸟湖是一座宽阔的北方湖泊，位于林木线以南，周围生长着云杉林。它属于卡赞河水系的源头地带，水流向北穿过卡斯巴湖等大湖，最终流向贝克湖。再往下游，森林逐渐让位于荒原开阔的苔原。南方湖区的德内猎人曾进入这一广大地区追逐驯鹿。

english:
Snowdon, or Yr Wyddfa, rises in the rugged mountains of Gwynedd in northwestern Wales. Steep slopes, ridges and valleys are better suited to grazing than extensive arable farming. Households used seasonal upland pasture and resources from lower ground. Passes and valley paths connected communities, although weather and terrain restricted travel.

In the Middle Ages, the wider Snowdonia region formed part of the heartland of the princes of Gwynedd. Mountains provided barriers and shaped routes for armies and officials. English conquest in the late thirteenth century changed the political order, while the Welsh language and local traditions continued. Early modern upland production connected communities with markets beyond the mountains; by the eighteenth century, more travellers came to appreciate and explore the scenery.
simp_chinese:
斯诺登山又称威德法山，位于威尔士西北部圭内斯的崎岖山区。陡坡、高脊和深切河谷更适合放牧，而非大面积耕作。当地家庭利用高地季节性牧场和较低处的资源，山口与谷地小路连接社区，但天气和地形常限制出行。

中世纪，斯诺登尼亚是圭内斯诸王的核心地区之一。群山提供屏障，也影响军队和官员的通行路线。十三世纪末英格兰的征服改变了政治秩序，威尔士语和地方传统仍在周围社区延续。近世高地生产与山外市场相连；到十八世纪，越来越多旅人也开始欣赏和探索这里的山景。

english: The Upper Spokane, known as the Muddy Creek people, lived along the Spokane River and its tributaries. Their villages near Spokane Falls and the mouth of Latah Creek stood beside important salmon and steelhead fisheries. In 1810 the North West Company established Spokane House farther downriver, near the meeting of the Spokane and Little Spokane, bringing the fur trade to an established gathering place.
simp_chinese: 上斯波坎人也被称为“泥溪之民”，生活在斯波坎河及其支流沿岸。他们在斯波坎瀑布和拉塔溪河口附近的村落，毗邻重要的鲑鱼与虹鳟渔场。1810年，西北公司在更下游的斯波坎河与小斯波坎河交会处附近建立斯波坎贸易站，将毛皮贸易带到这处已有的聚会地点。

english: The Portneuf River cuts through the mountain country of southeastern Idaho, passing hot springs that emerge along faults near its canyon. Shoshone and Bannock people gathered at these warm waters to bathe and rest. The Portneuf and Marsh Creek valleys also form a passage between the Bear River country and the Snake River plain, amid a landscape of mountain ridges and narrow river bottoms.
simp_chinese: 波特讷夫河穿过爱达荷东南部山地，沿途有温泉从河谷附近的断层中涌出。肖肖尼人与班诺克人曾聚集在温暖的泉水边沐浴休息。波特讷夫河谷与马什溪谷在山脊和狭窄河岸平地之间形成通路，连接贝尔河地区与蛇河平原。

english:
The Só’taeo’o, also known as Suhtai, were a people closely connected with the Cheyenne of the Great Plains. Northern and southern communities moved through the plains in their own camps, maintaining ties with other Cheyenne bands. The southern Só’taeo’o were closely associated with the Hisiometaneo. Together these peoples hunted bison and traveled across a landscape of rivers, grasslands and uplands, joining larger gatherings for shared ceremonies and councils.

The later city of Cheyenne lies here.
simp_chinese:
苏泰奥人又称苏泰人，是与大平原夏延人关系密切的民族。南北社群以各自的营地在平原迁徙，并与其他夏延群体保持联系。南方苏泰奥人与希西奥梅塔尼奥人关系尤其密切。他们猎取野牛，穿行于河流、草原和高地之间，也加入更大规模的聚会，举行共同仪式和会议。

后来的夏延即位于此地。

english: Soalara stands south of the Onilahy River's mouth on Madagascar's southwestern coast, facing Saint Augustine Bay. The bay opens to the Mozambique Channel, while the river connects the shore with the dry interior. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries English and other European vessels frequently visited the bay to obtain provisions and trade with local communities. Limestone country rises behind the shore, contrasting with the river and its fertile valley.
simp_chinese: 苏阿拉拉位于马达加斯加西南岸乌尼拉希河口以南，面向圣奥古斯丁湾。海湾通往莫桑比克海峡，河流则将海岸同干燥内陆连接起来。十七至十八世纪，英国及其他欧洲船只频繁到访海湾，与当地社群贸易并获取补给。海岸后方升起石灰岩地带，与河流及其肥沃河谷形成对照。

english:
Soba was the royal capital of Alodia, the southernmost of the Christian kingdoms of medieval Nubia. It stood on the Blue Nile above its meeting with the White Nile, in a belt of farmland that reached into the Sudanese interior. Arab visitors described a town of extensive dwellings, gardens and churches full of gold, and the largest of its churches was said to be the Church of Manbali. By about 1300 the decline of the kingdom was well advanced, and no pottery or glassware later than the thirteenth century has been found in the town.

Arab tribes, first recorded moving into Nubia in 1324, had settled the whole central Nile valley by the later fifteenth century, leaving only the country around Soba to its kings. Around 1500 the Nubians were said to have no king at all, only some 150 lordships grouped around castles on both banks of the river. Tradition credits the Arab chief Abdallah Jammah, allied with the Funj king Amara Dunqas, with destroying Soba, and one Shendi tradition dates its fall to 1509. The Funj founded Sennar in 1504–05. When the Jewish traveller David Reubeni passed by in 1523, he found Soba in ruins. People lived among the ruins until at least the early seventeenth century, and their bricks and stones went into the domed shrines of Sufi saints and, in the early nineteenth century, into the new town of Khartoum.
simp_chinese:
索巴是中世纪努比亚基督教诸王国中最南端的阿尔瓦的王都。城市坐落在青尼罗河畔，位于它与白尼罗河交汇处的上游，河岸农田一直延伸到苏丹内陆。阿拉伯来访者称这里有宽阔的住宅、园林和满是黄金装饰的教堂，其中最大的一座据说是曼巴利教堂。到1300年前后，王国的衰落已相当严重，城中再没有发现晚于13世纪的陶器和玻璃器。

阿拉伯部落在1324年首次见于记载地迁入努比亚，到15世纪后期已遍布尼罗河中段，只剩索巴周边留给国王。1500年前后，努比亚人据说已没有国王，只有约150个领主，分别据守尼罗河两岸的城堡。传说阿拉伯首领阿卜杜拉·贾马与丰吉国王阿马拉·敦卡斯结盟，摧毁了索巴；申迪的一种说法把陷落定在1509年。丰吉人于1504至1505年建立了森纳尔。犹太旅行者大卫·鲁本尼1523年路过时，看到的索巴已是一片废墟。人们至少到17世纪初仍住在废墟之间，城里的砖石被用来修建苏非圣徒的穹顶圣墓，19世纪初又被运去建造新城喀土穆。

english: Soba Gawe lies near the Lunga River in the upper Kafue basin. The Lunga is one of the Kafue's northern tributaries; farther downstream the Kafue winds through marshes before crossing the great Kafue Flats. Woodland of Brachystegia and related miombo trees covers much of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 索巴加韦位于卡富埃河上游流域，靠近隆加河。隆加河是卡富埃河北方支流之一；更下游，卡富埃河蜿蜒穿过沼泽，再横越广阔的卡富埃平原。短荚树等米翁博树木组成的林地覆盖周围大片地区。

english:
The Sobaipuri were O’odham people of the San Pedro and Santa Cruz river valleys, where villages and fields lay among the dry mountains of the Southwest. They farmed along the rivers and maintained ties with neighbouring communities. Quiburi, on the San Pedro, was an important settlement under the leader known to the Spanish as Captain Coro.

In 1698 a force of Sobaipuri from Quiburi and the Santa Cruz valley fought a raiding party that had attacked another village on the San Pedro. Coro’s people later moved west, returning to rebuild Quiburi in 1705. Continued warfare made life in the valley precarious; by 1762 the remaining Sobaipuri there had left for communities including Bac and Tucson, although their connections to the San Pedro endured.
simp_chinese:
索拜普里是圣佩德罗河与圣克鲁斯河谷的奥德汉人，村庄和田地分布在西南部干燥的山地之间。他们沿河耕作，并与邻近社群保持联系。圣佩德罗河上的基布里是一处重要聚落，首领被西班牙人称为科罗队长。

1698年，来自基布里与圣克鲁斯河谷的索拜普里战士迎击了一支袭击圣佩德罗河另一村庄的敌军。科罗的族人后来西迁，1705年返回重建基布里。持续战争使河谷生活愈发艰难；到1762年，剩余的索拜普里人离开此地，迁往巴克、图森等社群，但他们与圣佩德罗河的联系并未消失。

english: The Sobat River flows westward to the White Nile across the floodplains of the upper Nile basin. It begins where the Baro, descending from the Ethiopian highlands, meets the Pibor from the south. In flood the river carries sediment and spreads water across low ground. Nuer communities live along its banks, with the Lou associated with the south bank and the eastern Jikany with the north.
simp_chinese: 索巴特河向西穿过尼罗河上游盆地的洪泛平原，汇入白尼罗河。它由来自埃塞俄比亚高地的巴罗河和自南而来的皮博尔河汇合形成。洪水期河流携带泥沙，水漫低地。努尔人社群生活在河岸，卢人与南岸相联系，东吉卡尼人与北岸相联系。

english: Sobolevo lies near the Bolshaya Vorovskaya, a salmon river crossing the western Kamchatka lowland toward the Sea of Okhotsk. An Itelmen community inhabited this river country before the arrival of Russian Cossacks. The explorer Stepan Krasheninnikov related the Russian name of the river to resistance by its inhabitants against tribute collectors, a reminder of the violence that accompanied the extension of Russian rule on the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 索博列沃靠近大沃罗夫斯卡亚河，这条鲑鱼河穿过堪察加西部低地，流向鄂霍次克海。俄国哥萨克到来之前，伊捷尔缅社群已生活在河流地区。探险家斯捷潘·克拉舍宁尼科夫将河流的俄语名称与当地居民反抗贡赋征收者联系起来，记述了俄国统治扩展到半岛时伴随的暴力。

english: Soboloox lies near the right bank of the Indigirka, south of the meeting of that river with the Moma. Here the Indigirka emerges from the mountains of the Chersky system into the broad Moma–Selennyakh depression. The river has passed a series of rapids upstream, while its valley opens out between mountain ranges farther north. Forest and meadow occupy parts of the river country.
simp_chinese: 索博洛奥位于因迪吉尔卡河右岸附近，在莫马河与其汇合处以南。因迪吉尔卡河在这里走出切尔斯基山系，进入宽阔的莫马—谢连尼亚赫盆地。河水在上游经过一系列急流，向北则在群山之间展开更宽的河谷，河畔部分地带生长着森林与草地。

english:
Sochaczew lies west of Warsaw at a crossing of roads through Mazovia. First recorded in 1138, when Duke Bolesław III died at a local Benedictine monastery, its early stronghold became a castellany, and the town prospered from crafts and trade on routes linking Warsaw, Poznań and other centres. Duke Siemowit III built a castle here in the fourteenth century; Sochaczew later became a royal town of Poland.

Fires and the Swedish invasion brought ruin in the seventeenth century. After years of fighting, only thirteen inhabited houses remained in 1661. Recovery was slow, although a royal route between Warsaw and Dresden passed through the town in the eighteenth century. Prussia annexed Sochaczew in 1793; at that time its population included a large Jewish community.
simp_chinese:
索哈切夫位于华沙以西，是马佐夫舍道路的交会处。1138年的记载提到博莱斯瓦夫三世公爵在当地本笃会修道院去世。早期据点成为城堡辖区治所，城镇凭借连接华沙、波兹南等地的道路发展手工业与贸易。十四世纪，谢莫维特三世公爵在此修建城堡；索哈切夫后来成为波兰王室城镇。

十七世纪的火灾和瑞典入侵使城镇陷入废墟。多年战乱之后，1661年这里只剩十三座有人居住的房屋。尽管十八世纪华沙与德累斯顿之间的王室道路经过此地，城镇恢复仍十分缓慢。1793年普鲁士吞并索哈切夫，当时居民中有一个庞大的犹太社群。

english: Sjokksjokk was a Forest Sámi community in the wooded country of Lule Lappmark. Its inhabitants drew on fishing and hunting as well as reindeer, moving between resources scattered across the forest. Reindeer were useful for transport as well as for herding, and the community's land formed part of a wider pattern of Sámi use of the northern interior. In the eighteenth century, grazing rights in Sjokksjokk were shared with Mountain Sámi whose herds came down to the forests in winter. Such arrangements joined communities with different seasonal movements on the same land, even as the Swedish state increasingly sought to regulate its use.
simp_chinese: 绍克绍克是吕勒拉普马克林地中的森林萨米社群。居民捕鱼狩猎，也饲养驯鹿，在森林中分散的资源地之间移动。驯鹿既用于放牧，也用于运输；这片土地是萨米人利用北方内陆广大地域的一部分。十八世纪，绍克绍克的放牧权由当地人与冬季将鹿群赶入森林的山地萨米人共同享有。季节迁徙方式不同的社群因而在同一片土地上相遇，而瑞典国家也日益试图规范土地的使用。

english:
Sodankylä lies by the Kitinen River in the forests of central Lapland. Sámi communities used the surrounding rivers and fells long before a permanent church was first raised here. In 1688 King Charles XI provided funds for its construction, and the small timber church was completed the following year. Its log walls, low roof and wooden fittings give it the character of an old northern chapel.

The church served a wide but sparsely populated district of Kemi Lapland. In 1747 Sodankylä became an independent parish, encompassing the villages of Sodankylä, Sompio, Kemikylä and Kittilä. People travelled from distant river valleys and forests to gather at the church and market place, bringing together communities whose seasonal lives extended far beyond the church village.
simp_chinese:
索丹屈莱位于拉普兰中部森林中的基蒂宁河畔。永久教堂建成之前，萨米社区早已利用周围河流和山地。1688年，卡尔十一世国王拨款建堂，这座小木教堂于次年竣工。原木墙、低矮屋顶和木质陈设赋予它古老北方礼拜堂的面貌。

教堂服务于人口稀少而地域广阔的凯米拉普兰。1747年，索丹屈莱成为独立教区，管辖索丹屈莱、松皮奥、凯米屈莱和基蒂莱等村。居民从远处河谷和森林前来，在教堂与集市聚集；这些社区的季节性生活范围远远超出教堂村本身。

english: Soddo lies in the southern highlands of Wolaita, a country once ruled by kings known as kawo. Agriculture was the foundation of the kingdom, with trade and crafts supplementing the work of cultivators. In the early nineteenth century the royal centre moved from Didaye hill in the northwest to Damota hill near Soddo, bringing the seat of Wolaita's kings into this part of the highlands.
simp_chinese: 索多位于沃莱塔南部高地，这片土地曾由称为卡沃的国王统治。农业是王国的基础，贸易和手工业则补充耕作者的生计。十九世纪初，王室中心从西北方的迪达耶山迁至索多附近的达莫塔山，沃莱塔诸王的驻地由此转移到这一高地地区。

english: Söderala is an old parish in Hälsingland, inland from the coast of the Bothnian Sea. Its stone church is among the oldest in northern Sweden, with a history reaching back to the Middle Ages. Paintings added in the sixteenth century decorate its interior. The church served the farming communities of the district long before the nearby port of Söderhamn grew into a town.
simp_chinese: 南阿拉是海尔辛兰的古老教区，位于波的尼亚海海岸内陆。当地石教堂是瑞典北部最古老的教堂之一，历史可追溯到中世纪，内部饰有16世纪增添的壁画。早在附近港口南雪平发展为城镇之前，这座教堂便已服务于当地农业社区。

english: Söderbärke stands on a narrow isthmus by Lake Barken in the ironworking country of Bergslagen. A stone church was built here in the fourteenth century, serving farms and settlements around the lake. Finnish settlers came into the surrounding forests in the seventeenth century as ironworking developed. In the early eighteenth century the church was enlarged, with substantial support from owners of the Larsbo and Malingsbo works, linking its rebuilding to the prosperity of the local iron industry.
simp_chinese: 南拜尔克位于贝里斯拉根炼铁地区，坐落在巴尔肯湖畔狭窄的地峡上。十四世纪这里建起石教堂，服务于湖周围的农场与聚落。随着炼铁业发展，芬兰移民在十七世纪进入周边森林。十八世纪初，教堂获得拉尔斯布和马林斯布铁厂业主的大力资助而扩建，其重建与地方铁业的繁荣相联系。

english:
Located on the Storå River where it reaches the Baltic at the head of a sheltered estuary, Söderköping grew through the 12th and 13th centuries into one of the most important ports in Sweden, its quays crowded with the cogs of Lübeck and Visby loading the iron and copper of inland Sweden for the markets of the south. A royal market town with a substantial German burgher community governing under Lübeck-derived privileges, the city hosted royal coronations, treaty negotiations, and the great fair that drew merchants from across the Baltic each summer. Though the slow silting of its waterway had already begun to threaten its harbor, Söderköping in the early 14th century remains one of the principal trading places of the Swedish east coast.

Söderköping kept its weight in the kingdom's affairs through the 14th and 15th centuries: an assembly here re-elected Magnus Eriksson king in 1359, and in 1436 Eric of Pomerania made peace in the town with Engelbrekt's rebels. Its decline came by degrees. Gustav Vasa closed the Franciscan friary, and after a Danish army ravaged the town in 1567 it never regained its old standing, though Duke Charles still summoned a Riksdag here in 1595 to strengthen his hand against King Sigismund. All the while the land was slowly rising, the shallow waterway grew ever harder going for the deep-draught Hanseatic cogs, and by the early 18th century the trade of the district had passed to Norrköping.
simp_chinese:
在斯托河汇入波罗的海的避风河口处，南雪平在12世纪和13世纪发展成为瑞典领地最重要的港口之一，码头上挤满了来自吕贝克和维斯比的柯格船，将瑞典内陆的铁和铜装载起来运往南方市场。这座王室集市城镇拥有一个规模不小的德国市民社区，在源自吕贝克的特权下自治，曾举办过王室加冕、条约谈判，以及每年夏天吸引波罗的海各地商人前来的盛大集市。尽管水道的缓慢淤塞已经开始威胁到港口，但在14世纪初，南雪平仍然是瑞典东海岸主要的贸易地点之一。

14、15世纪，南雪平在王国事务中仍有分量：1359年，这里的一次集会再次推举马格努斯·埃里克松为国王；1436年，波美拉尼亚的埃里克在城中与恩格尔布雷克特的起义者议和。衰落是一步步来的。古斯塔夫·瓦萨关闭了方济各会修道院，1567年丹麦军队蹂躏城镇之后，它再也没有恢复昔日的地位，尽管1595年查理公爵仍在这里召开等级议会，以加强自己对抗西吉斯蒙德国王的力量。与此同时，陆地缓慢抬升，吃水深的汉萨柯格船越来越难驶过浅浅的水道，到18世纪初，这一带的贸易已转到诺尔雪平。

english:
Södertälje lies at the passage between Lake Mälaren and the Baltic Sea. As the old strait narrowed, boats had to be hauled across a ridge, encouraging trade and services at the crossing. Known simply as Tälje or Telge in earlier sources, the town received privileges in the fourteenth century.

Telge Hus castle was built during the fourteenth century on Slottsholmen. From 1318 to 1527 it served as a centre for the surrounding administrative district. In 1622 the prefix Söder, meaning south, was added to the town's name to distinguish it from the newly founded Norrtälje. The passage between inland waters and the sea remained central to its identity.
simp_chinese:
南泰利耶位于梅拉伦湖通往波罗的海的通道上。古代海峡逐渐变窄后，船只需要被拖过沙脊，带动了渡口的贸易与服务。这里早先称泰利耶或特尔格，14世纪获得城镇特权。

14世纪，特尔格胡斯城堡建于斯洛茨霍尔门岛；1318至1527年，它是周围行政区的管理中心。1622年，城镇名称加上意为“南”的前缀 Söder，以区别新建的北泰利耶。内陆水域与海洋之间的通道始终是当地的重要特征。

english: Sodwana Bay faces the Indian Ocean along a coast of sandy beaches and forested dunes. Offshore reefs shelter a rich variety of fish and other marine life in warm subtropical water. Loggerhead and leatherback turtles come ashore to lay their eggs in the sand, while the Agulhas Current carries warm water south along the coast. The reef and beach form contrasting habitats beside the open ocean.
simp_chinese: 索德瓦纳湾面向印度洋，沿岸分布沙滩与林木覆盖的沙丘。近海礁石在温暖的亚热带海水中庇护着多种鱼类和其他海洋生物。红海龟与棱皮龟上岸在沙中产卵，厄加勒斯洋流则沿海向南输送温水。礁石和海滩在开阔大洋旁形成不同的栖息环境。

english:
Soest stood at the meeting of long-distance roads across Westphalia and became one of the region's foremost medieval towns. Its merchants traded through the Hanseatic network as far as Scandinavia and Russia, while churches and town walls displayed the prosperity of the surrounding Börde. In 1253 Soest joined Dortmund, Münster and Lippstadt in an alliance to protect their common trade.

The town's independence brought it into conflict with its lord, the archbishop of Cologne. In 1444 Soest renounced his authority and sought the protection of Cleves, beginning a five-year feud. An arbitration in 1449 confirmed its allegiance to the Duke of Cleves. Although the citizens preserved their liberties, the city and its territory became increasingly isolated from their former trading connections, and Soest's regional importance declined.
simp_chinese:
索斯特位于横贯威斯特伐利亚的远程道路交汇处，成为中世纪该地区最重要的城镇之一。商人通过汉萨网络远赴斯堪的纳维亚和罗斯贸易，教堂与城墙则展示了周围博尔德地区的富庶。1253年，索斯特与多特蒙德、明斯特和利普施塔特结盟，保护共同的商业利益。

城镇的独立精神使它与领主科隆大主教发生冲突。1444年，索斯特宣布脱离主教的权威，寻求克莱沃保护，由此引发长达五年的索斯特争斗。1449年的仲裁确认它归属克莱沃公爵。市民虽然保住了自由，城市及其领地却与原有贸易联系日益隔绝，索斯特的地区重要性也逐渐下降。

english:
At the southern end of the Swahili coast, where the Zambezi country opens onto the Indian Ocean, Sofala served from the 10th century as the great outlet for the gold of the African interior. The kingdom of Great Zimbabwe sent its gold down the long caravan routes to be exchanged at Sofala for the silks of China, the ceramics of Persia, and the cottons of India that the dhows of the monsoon brought down each year from Kilwa and beyond. The Arab geographer al-Mas'udi visited in the 10th century, and under the Mahdali sultans of Kilwa the city became an obedient outpost of the great northern Swahili polity, its prosperity wholly dependent on the gold trade and the cycles of the monsoon.

By the time the Portuguese came, the gold that made Sofala's name was already running thin. Pêro da Covilhã, who reached the town in 1489 disguised as an Arab merchant, still reported a gold market to Lisbon, and in 1505 the aged Sheikh Isuf, at odds with a usurper in Kilwa, let Pêro de Anaia build a fortress beside the town. It proved a poor prize. The site was unhealthy, 76 of the garrison died in the first months of 1506, and the Muslim merchants kept the fort short of food. Meanwhile the shifting sandbar at the river mouth and the worn-out goldfields were drawing the trade north to the Zambezi, and once Portugal took Mozambique Island in 1507, the fort at Sofala was left a minor outpost.

The later city of Beira lies here.
simp_chinese:
在斯瓦希里海岸的南端，赞比西河流域通往印度洋的地方，索法拉自10世纪起一直是非洲内陆黄金的重要出口港。大津巴布韦王国将黄金沿长途商路运来，在索法拉交换中国的丝绸、波斯的陶瓷和印度的棉布，这些货物由季风帆船每年从基尔瓦及更远的地方运来。阿拉伯地理学家马苏迪曾在10世纪到访过此地，在基尔瓦的马赫达利苏丹统治下，这座城市已成为北方斯瓦希里大政体的一个顺从前哨，其繁荣完全依赖黄金贸易和季风的周期。

葡萄牙人到来的时候，使索法拉闻名的黄金已经在渐渐枯竭。1489年，佩罗·达·科维良假扮阿拉伯商人来到这里，仍向里斯本报告说这是个黄金市场；1505年，年迈的谢赫伊苏夫正与基尔瓦的篡位者不和，便允许佩罗·德·阿纳亚在城边修建堡垒。结果得不偿失。此地水土不好，1506年头几个月驻军就死了76人，穆斯林商人又断绝粮食供应。与此同时，河口移动的沙洲和采尽的旧金矿正把贸易引向北面的赞比西河；1507年葡萄牙人夺取莫桑比克岛之后，索法拉的堡垒就只剩下一个无足轻重的前哨。

后来的贝拉即位于此地。

english: Sofala stood on the Mozambican coast where waterways connected the Indian Ocean with markets inland. Swahili merchants traded here for gold brought from the plateau, sending it onward through coastal networks. Seeking a share of this commerce, the Portuguese built a fort and trading post at Sofala in 1505. The port remained tied to the inland kingdom of Kiteve, even as Portuguese settlements along the Zambezi gained importance.
simp_chinese: 索法拉位于莫桑比克海岸，水道将印度洋与内陆市场相连。斯瓦希里商人在此交换从高原运来的黄金，再经沿海网络向外输送。葡萄牙人希望参与这项贸易，于1505年在索法拉建立堡垒和商站。即使葡萄牙人在赞比西河沿岸的聚落日益重要，索法拉仍与内陆的基泰韦王国保持联系。

english: Sofiivka lies in the steppe between the Bazavluk and Saksahan rivers, east of Kryvyi Rih. The village was founded in the 1790s on land associated with General Dunin, who named it for Sofia. Its establishment followed the settlement of the country between the two rivers by farming families in the later eighteenth century. The Bazavluk flows south towards the Dnipro through the former lands of the Zaporozhian Cossacks.
simp_chinese: 索菲伊夫卡位于克里维里赫以东、巴扎夫卢克河与萨克萨汉河之间的草原上。村庄建立于十八世纪九十年代，与杜宁将军的土地有关，并以索菲娅命名。此前，农业家庭已在十八世纪后期迁入两河之间的地带。巴扎夫卢克河穿过扎波罗热哥萨克旧地，向南流向第聂伯河。

sources.title: sofvskijj rajjon admnstrativnijj centr  smt sofvka.html

english: Soghan lies in a valley of southern Kerman, where the ancient mound of Tepe Yahya rises above the plain. In the third millennium BCE, craftspeople there carved vessels from the soft chlorite found in the surrounding hills. Their designs included geometric patterns, animals and plants; related vessels travelled as far as Mesopotamia, the Persian Gulf and the Indus. Fields and orchards occupy the valley amid the mountains of this inland region.
simp_chinese: 索甘位于克尔曼南部的山谷中，古老的泰佩叶海亚遗址丘耸立在平原之上。公元前三千纪，当地工匠用附近山中的软绿泥石雕制器皿，装饰几何图案、动物和植物。类似器皿远达美索不达米亚、波斯湾和印度河流域。山谷中的田地与果园坐落在这片内陆地区的群山之间。

english:
Sogndal lies among the valleys and inlets on the northern side of the Sognefjord. Nearby Kaupanger takes its name from an old trading place, and its stave church recalls the settlement that grew beside the fjord. The wooden church was built around the end of the twelfth century, after an earlier church was lost when King Sverre's men burned the market place in 1184.

Its nave was lengthened during the Middle Ages and supported by additional wooden staves. The church remained a place of worship for the surrounding communities through the centuries that followed. In 1720 the judge Giert Anderssøn Heiberg obtained permission to build a private stone burial chapel against its northern wall, adding a family monument to the much older timber building.
simp_chinese:
松恩达尔位于松恩峡湾北岸的山谷和支湾之间。附近的考庞厄尔得名于古老的贸易场所，木板教堂使人想起这处峡湾聚落的历史。1184年国王斯韦雷的部下焚毁集市，原有教堂也被烧毁，此后人们在12世纪末前后建起新的木教堂。

中世纪期间，教堂中殿向西延长，并增添了承重木柱。此后数百年，教堂持续服务于周围社区。1720年，法官耶特·安德松·海贝格获准在北墙旁修筑私人石质墓室，为这座古老的木建筑增添了家族纪念建筑。

english:
Sogne Fjord cuts deeply into western Norway, carrying seawater between steep mountains and narrow strips of inhabited ground. Boats offer connections between places that are difficult to join by land. Communities combine fishing, farming, and livestock keeping, using valley floors, slopes, and upland pasture according to the season. The fjord provides shelter compared with the exposed coast, but winds, weather, and the distances between settlements still demand experienced navigation.

Communities around the fjord were connected to Norway's coastal economy. At Hove, a medieval stone church overlooking the fjord reflects the resources and contacts of its builders; Bergen was a major market for fish and products of farming and forestry. These examples illuminate the wider network in which fjord communities moved people and goods by water, though they do not describe every settlement along its shores.
simp_chinese:
松恩峡湾深入挪威西部，在陡峭山岭与狭窄居住地带之间引入海水。舟船连接陆路难以互通的地点。社群结合捕鱼、耕作和畜养，按照季节利用谷底、坡地与高山牧场。相较暴露海岸，峡湾提供庇护，但风向、天气和聚落之间距离，仍要求熟练航行。

峡湾周围的社群与挪威沿海经济相连。霍沃俯瞰峡湾的中世纪石教堂体现建造者的资源与联系；卑尔根则是鱼类、农产品和林产品的重要市场。这些例子展现峡湾居民通过水路运送人口和货物的更大网络，但不能代表每一处沿岸聚落的历史。

english: Sogra is a stretch of forest and wetland in the northern river country east of the Vaga. The Vaga joins the Northern Dvina, whose waters flow north to the White Sea, while smaller rivers drain the surrounding wooded land. Bogs and thick forest make this a difficult country to cross, quite unlike the settled banks along the great rivers. The river valleys furnished the main routes through the interior toward Shenkursk and the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 索格拉是瓦加河以东俄罗斯北方河流地带的一片森林与湿地。瓦加河汇入北德维纳河，后者向北流入白海；小河则为周围林地排水。沼泽与密林使这里难以通行，与大河沿岸有人居住的地区截然不同。河谷构成穿越内陆、通往申库尔斯克和白海的主要道路。

english:
Söğüt lies in the northwestern Anatolian hills near the Sakarya, on what was once a frontier between Byzantine lands and the Seljuk world. Ottoman tradition remembers it as the winter quarters of Ertuğrul and his followers. His son Osman emerged here as the leader of a small principality in the late thirteenth century, giving his name to a dynasty that would rule an empire.

Many stories about the earliest Ottomans were recorded long after their lifetimes, but the association of Osman and his father with Söğüt remained central to the dynasty's memory. The town contains a tomb attributed to Ertuğrul and a mosque bearing his name, both altered in later centuries. From this frontier base Osman and his followers took neighbouring Byzantine strongholds, including Bilecik. As Ottoman power expanded, the political centre moved to larger cities, but Söğüt retained its place in accounts of the dynasty's beginnings.
simp_chinese:
瑟于特位于安纳托利亚西北部萨卡里亚河附近的丘陵中，曾处在拜占庭领地与塞尔柱世界之间的边疆。奥斯曼传统将它记为埃尔图鲁尔及其追随者的冬季驻地。十三世纪末，他的儿子奥斯曼在此成为小公国的领袖，并将名字留给后来统治帝国的王朝。

许多关于早期奥斯曼人的故事是在当事人去世很久之后记下的，但奥斯曼父子与瑟于特的联系始终是王朝记忆的核心。镇上有归属于埃尔图鲁尔的陵墓和以他命名的清真寺，两者均在后世经过改建。奥斯曼及其追随者从这处边疆基地夺取附近拜占庭要塞，包括比莱吉克。随着奥斯曼势力扩张，政治中心迁往更大的城市，但瑟于特在王朝起源的叙述中保有地位。

english:
Sohagpur lies in the wooded country south of Bandhavgarh. Its Virateshwar temple, dedicated to Shiva, rises above an old settlement rich in carved stone and other remains. The temple belongs to the artistic world of the Kalachuri rulers, whose power extended across this part of central India; scholars have placed it in the eleventh or twelfth century. Local tradition remembers the place as Viratpuri, associated with King Virata and the exile of the Pandava brothers.

A later ruling family of Sohagpur traced its origin to Jamni Bhan, a younger son of the Baghela ruler Virbhan Singh. He settled here and encouraged newcomers to clear and inhabit the surrounding land. In the early nineteenth century much of the Sohagpur and Bandhavgarh country passed to the Marathas and then to the British, as the authority of the older regional rulers changed.
simp_chinese:
索哈格布尔位于班达夫加尔以南的森林地区。供奉湿婆的毗罗提什瓦尔寺高耸于古老聚落之上，附近散布石雕和其他遗存。寺庙属于卡拉丘里统治者的艺术传统；学者将它定为十一或十二世纪的建筑。地方传说称这里是毗罗吒城，与毗罗吒王和般度兄弟的流放故事相关。

索哈格布尔后来的统治家族将起源追溯至巴盖拉君主维尔班·辛格的次子贾姆尼·班。他在这里定居，并鼓励新来者开垦周围土地。十九世纪初，索哈格布尔与班达夫加尔的大部分地区先后转入马拉塔人和英国人之手，旧有地方统治者的权力随之改变。

english: The northern waters of West Korea Bay receive the Yalu River, which flows out between the Korean and Liaodong shores. The river's lower course was an important frontier route as well as a boundary. In 1593, during the Japanese invasion of Korea, a market was opened at Chunggang opposite Ŭiju for trade with Ming China. Beyond the river mouth the bay broadens into the Yellow Sea.
simp_chinese: 西朝鲜湾北部接纳鸭绿江，江水从朝鲜与辽东海岸之间流出。河流下游既是边界，也是重要的边疆通道。1593年日本入侵朝鲜期间，朝廷在义州对岸的中江开设市场，与明朝贸易。越过江口，海湾逐渐展宽，通向黄海。

english:
Sohra stands on the southern edge of the Khasi Hills, above the plains of Bengal. Clouds driven against the escarpment bring extraordinary monsoon rains, feeding waterfalls that plunge from the plateau. Khasi communities inhabited the surrounding hills, whose chiefs governed their own territories and dealt with neighbours across the highland and lowland frontier. The British called the place Cherrapunji.

In the 1820s the British official David Scott chose Sohra as a station in the Khasi Hills. Its wet climate soon attracted notice: in 1827 Scott complained of almost unbroken rain and mist, and in 1832 the physician William Cracroft began measuring its rainfall. His observations recorded nearly 577 centimetres over four months, giving an early indication of the remarkable force of the monsoon on this exposed edge of the plateau.
simp_chinese:
索赫拉坐落在卡西丘陵南缘，俯瞰孟加拉平原。季风云层受山崖阻挡，在这里带来惊人的雨量，溪水从高原倾泻而下，形成瀑布。周围山地是卡西人的家园，各地首领统治自己的领地，并与高地和平原的邻人往来。英国人称此地为乞拉朋齐。

十九世纪二十年代，英国官员戴维·斯科特在索赫拉设立驻地。这里潮湿的气候很快引起注意：1827年，斯科特抱怨雨雾几乎不曾停歇；1832年，医生威廉·克拉克罗夫特开始测量降雨，四个月里便记录到近577厘米。这些早期观测显示了季风在高原迎风边缘的巨大力量。

english: Suhraward lies in the high country between Zanjan and Bijar. It gave its name to Shihab al-Din Suhrawardi, the philosopher born here in 1154 and later known as the Master of Illumination. After studying at Maragha and Isfahan, he travelled to Anatolia and Aleppo, where he died in 1191. His philosophy placed light at the centre of its account of existence, and his writings continued to be studied in Islamic philosophical circles for centuries.
simp_chinese: 索赫拉瓦尔德位于赞詹与比贾尔之间的高地，是哲学家希哈布丁·苏赫拉瓦尔迪的出生地。他于1154年生于此，后来被称为“光照大师”。在马拉盖和伊斯法罕求学后，他游历安纳托利亚，最终于1191年在阿勒颇去世。他的哲学以光为理解存在的核心，其著作在伊斯兰哲学界流传研习了数个世纪。

sources.title: Shihab al-Din Yahya ibn Habash Suhrawardi

english: Sohr and Firuzan lies southwest of Isfahan beside the Zayandeh Rud, among the cultivated settlements of its river valley. The Baba Mahmud bridge crosses the river nearby, its arches carrying a road between the two banks. It was built in the Ilkhanid period and is associated with Baba Mahmud, a local notable and official under the ruler Öljeitü. The bridge and its later repairs show the enduring importance of crossing the river that waters the fields and gardens of Isfahan's hinterland.
simp_chinese: 索赫尔与菲鲁赞位于伊斯法罕西南的扎扬德河畔，是河谷耕作地区的聚落之一。附近的巴巴马哈茂德桥跨越河流，拱券承托着连接两岸的道路。桥建于伊儿汗国时期，与完者都统治下的地方名士兼官员巴巴马哈茂德有关。桥梁及后来的修缮，体现了跨越这条滋养伊斯法罕腹地田园的河流始终十分重要。

english: The Soikino peninsula projects into the southern shore of the Gulf of Finland. Finnic-speaking peoples lived here long before the region came under the influence of Novgorod. Sixteenth-century cadastral books describe villages on the Soikino hills by the sea as part of the Kargala parish in the Koporye district of Novgorod's Vodskaya division. The peninsula belonged to Swedish Ingria for much of the seventeenth century, when settlers known as the Äyrämöiset began to arrive; it later returned to Russian rule.
simp_chinese: 索伊基诺半岛从芬兰湾南岸伸入海中。早在这一带进入诺夫哥罗德的影响范围之前，讲芬兰语族语言的人群便已在此居住。十六世纪的土地登记簿记载了“海边索伊基诺山上的村庄”，它们属于诺夫哥罗德沃德斯卡亚区科波里耶县的卡尔加拉教区。十七世纪的大部分时间里，半岛属于瑞典的英格里亚省，埃于拉迈宁人开始迁入；此后它又归俄罗斯统治。

english:
Soissons stands on the Aisne, a royal and episcopal city whose cathedral and abbeys testified to its long importance. On a hill above the town rose Saint-Jean-des-Vignes, a wealthy abbey of regular canons, distinguished by the towers of its church. The river crossing also gave the fortified city military value on the road towards Paris.

During the Revolution the canons were expelled in 1790 and the abbey became a military store. Its church was dismantled from 1805, and the proceeds from its materials were assigned to repairs of the cathedral; the façade was spared. In 1814 allied troops besieged Soissons during Napoleon's campaign in France. The town's capitulation gave the allies a crossing of the Aisne, allowing Blücher to regroup before the battle of Laon.
simp_chinese:
苏瓦松位于埃纳河畔，是一座王室与主教城市，主教座堂和修道院见证了它悠久的重要地位。城上山丘耸立着圣让德维涅修道院，这座富有的法政会修道院以教堂塔楼著称。渡口也使设防城市在通往巴黎的道路上具有军事价值。

大革命期间，修士于1790年被逐出，修道院改作军事仓库。1805年起，修道院教堂逐渐被拆除，建筑材料所得用于修复主教座堂；立面则得以保留。1814年拿破仑的法国战役期间，联军围攻苏瓦松。城镇投降后，联军得以渡过埃纳河，布吕歇尔遂在拉昂战役前重整部队。

english: Sojas lies in the highland country south of Zanjan, amid the valleys that drain towards the Qezel Ozan. Its Friday mosque is a small but distinguished monument of Seljuk architecture. Built of brick and crowned by a dome, it preserves inscriptions and a prayer niche decorated in stucco. The mosque's compact form stands in contrast to the open fields and bare hills around the settlement, and recalls the long history of religious patronage in this part of northwestern Iran.
simp_chinese: 索贾斯位于赞詹以南的高地，周围谷地的水流汇向克孜尔乌赞河。当地主麻清真寺虽小，却是杰出的塞尔柱建筑。它以砖砌成，上覆穹顶，保存着铭文和灰泥装饰的礼拜龛。紧凑的建筑与聚落周围开阔田野及裸露山丘形成对照，使人想起伊朗西北部长期的宗教赞助历史。

english: Sok lies in the mountain country of northern Tibet, east of Nagchu. Its landscape of high valleys and grazing grounds is marked by Zandan Monastery, a Gelug foundation whose buildings rise above the surrounding settlement. The monastery was founded in 1667 by Ngawang Losang Gyatso, and its great image of Maitreya became a focus of devotion for the people of the district.
simp_chinese: 索位于那曲以东的藏北山地，境内高谷与牧场相间。格鲁派赞丹寺建筑耸立在聚落之上，是当地醒目的宗教中心。寺院由阿旺洛桑加措于1667年创建，寺内巨大的强巴佛像成为地方信众礼敬的对象。

english: Sokal stands on the Bug in the historic land of Belz. Granted Magdeburg rights by Duke Siemowit IV in 1424, it became part of Belz Voivodeship in 1462. The frontier remained vulnerable: in 1519 Crimean Tatars defeated a Polish-Lithuanian army under Konstanty Ostrogski nearby and razed the town. In the early seventeenth century a Bernardine monastery and church were built here, housing an image of Our Lady of Sokal that drew Catholic pilgrims.
simp_chinese: 索卡利位于历史上的贝尔兹地区，坐落在布格河畔。1424年，谢莫维特四世公爵授予它马格德堡法权；1462年，城镇成为贝尔兹省的一部分。边境依然容易受到攻击：1519年，克里米亚鞑靼人在附近击败康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗格斯基率领的波兰立陶宛军，并将城镇夷平。十七世纪初，这里建起一座伯尔纳铎会修道院和教堂，供奉吸引天主教朝圣者的索卡利圣母像。

english: Sokhumi Bay lies on the eastern Black Sea coast below the wooded mountains of the Caucasus. The ancient port of Dioscurias stood here, later known as Sebastopolis and Tskhumi. Its harbour connected the coast of Colchis with maritime trade across the sea. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries Genoese merchants maintained a trading post and consul at the port, exchanging goods with the communities of the surrounding coast and hinterland.
simp_chinese: 苏呼米湾位于黑海东岸，高加索山脉的林木山坡俯临海湾。古港狄奥斯库里亚斯坐落于此，后来又称塞巴斯托波利斯和茨胡米。港口将科尔基斯海岸与横跨黑海的贸易联系起来。十四至十五世纪，热那亚商人在此设商站和领事，与周围沿海及内陆社群交换货物。

english: Sokilets lies on the Southern Bug near Nemyriv, opposite the settlement of Pechera. The river here runs between rocky banks, and an island provided a defensible site. In 1603 Prince Janusz Zbaraski ordered a new castle built on the island. The settlement belonged to a landscape of fortified estates along the Bug, where landholders contested possession and sought protection against raids.
simp_chinese: 索基列茨位于涅米里夫附近的南布格河畔，与佩切拉隔河相望。河水在此流经岩石岸壁，河中岛屿提供了易于防守的地点。1603年，亚努什·兹巴拉斯基公爵下令在岛上修建新城堡。这里属于沿布格河分布的设防庄园地带，领主争夺土地，并设法抵御袭击。

english: Sokna is an oasis of northern Fezzan, where palms and gardens stand amid the dry interior of Libya. It belongs to the chain of settlements around the Jufra depression, between the Mediterranean coast and the oases farther south.
